oldCfg.Privileged != newCfg.Privileged {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Privileged\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CgroupnsMode != newCfg.CgroupnsMode {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CgroupnsMode\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CgroupParent != newCfg.CgroupParent {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CgroupParent\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.PidMode != newCfg.PidMode {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"PidMode\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.MapsEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Tmpfs, newCfg.Tmpfs) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Tmpfs\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.SecurityOpts, newCfg.SecurityOpts) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"SecurityOpts\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.ShmSize != newCfg.ShmSize {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"ShmSize\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.PortSetsEqual(oldCfg.PortSet, newCfg.PortSet) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Ports\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.User != newCfg.User {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"User\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.NetworkMode != newCfg.NetworkMode {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"NetworkMode\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.MgmtNet != newCfg.MgmtNet {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"MgmtNet\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Runtime != newCfg.Runtime {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Runtime\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CPU != newCfg.CPU {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CPU\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CPUSet != newCfg.CPUSet {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CPUSet\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Memory != newCfg.Memory {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Memory\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.License != newCfg.License {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"License\")\n\t}\n\t_, oldInvalid := oldCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(InvalidKindSpecificConfig)\n\t_, newInvalid := newCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(InvalidKindSpecificConfig)\n\n\tif oldInvalid || newInvalid ||\n\t\t!reflect.DeepEqual(oldCfg.KindSpecificConfig, newCfg.KindSpecificConfig) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"KindSpecificConfig\")\n\t}\n\n\treturn diff\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) ComputeReconcilePlan(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) *ReconcileResult {\n\tresult := &ReconcileResult{Action: clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone}\n\n\tif diff == nil || !diff.HasDiff() {\n\t\treturn result\n\t}\n\n\taction := diff.DefaultAction()\n\tresult.Action = action\n\n\tswitch action {\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:\n\t\tresult.Restarted = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:\n\t\tresult.Recreated = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}\n\t}\n\n\treturn result\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetReconcilePlan(\n\t_ context.Context,\n\tdiff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,\n) (*ReconcileResult, error) {\n\treturn d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff), nil\n}\n\n// Reconcile applies the diff and executes the appropriate action (restart/recreate).\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) Reconcile(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tdiff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,\n) (*ReconcileResult, error) {\n\tresult := d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff)\n\n\tif result.Action == clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {\n\t\treturn result, nil\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Info(\n\t\t\"Applying node changes\",\n\t\t\"node\",\n\t\td.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\"action\",\n\t\tresult.Action,\n\t\t\"fields\",\n\t\tdiff.Fields,\n\t)\n\n\tswitch result.Action {\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:\n\t\tif err := d.Stop(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn result, fmt.Errorf(\"stop failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := d.Start(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn result, fmt.Errorf(\"start failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:\n\t\tif err := d.Delete(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn result, fmt.Errorf(\"delete failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn result, nil\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) parkingNetNSName() string {\n\treturn clabutils.ParkingNetnsName(d.Cfg.LongName)\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) parkingNetNSPath() (string, error) {\n\treturn clabutils.GetNamedNetNS(d.parkingNetNSName())\n}\n\n// cleanupParkingNetNS removes the node-owned parking namespace if it exists.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) cleanupParkingNetNS() error {\n\tif _, err := d.parkingNetNSPath(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn netns.DeleteNamed(d.parkingNetNSName())\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tfor _, e := range d.Endpoints {\n\t\terr := e.GetLink().Remove(ctx)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn d.Runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetImages(_ context.Context) map[string]string {\n\treturn map[string]string{\n\t\tImageKey: d.Cfg.Image,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {\n\tcnts, err := d.Runtime.ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tFilterType: \"name\",\n\t\t\tMatch:      d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),\n\t\t},\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\t// check that we retrieved some container information\n\t// otherwise throw ErrContainersNotFound error\n\tif len(cnts) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"Node: %s. %w\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),\n\t\t\tErrContainersNotFound,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn cnts, err\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) RunExecFromConfig(ctx context.Context, ec *clabexec.ExecCollection) error {\n\tfor _, e := range d.Config().Exec {\n\t\texec, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(e)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\"Failed to parse the command string: %s, %v\", e, err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tres, err := d.OverwriteNode.RunExec(ctx, exec)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t// kinds which do not support exec functionality are skipped\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tec.Add(d.GetShortName(), res)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tcnts, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif len(cnts) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"no container runtime information retrieved\")\n\t}\n\n\t// network settings of a first container only\n\tnetSettings := cnts[0].NetworkSettings\n\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = netSettings.IPv4addr\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv4pLen\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address = netSettings.IPv6addr\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv6pLen\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway = netSettings.IPv4Gw\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway = netSettings.IPv6Gw\n\n\td.Cfg.ContainerID = cnts[0].ID\n\n\td.Cfg.ResultingPortBindings = cnts[0].Ports\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Deleting %s network namespace\", d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())\n\treturn clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceOverlap() error {\n\tvar seenEps []clablinks.Endpoint\n\n\tfor _, ep := range d.Endpoints {\n\t\tifName := ep.GetIfaceName()\n\t\tfor _, seenEp := range seenEps {\n\t\t\tif ifName == seenEp.GetIfaceName() {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%q and %q have overlapping interface names\", ep, seenEp)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tseenEps = append(seenEps, ep)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// CheckInterfaceName checks if a name of the interface referenced in the topology file is in the\n// expected range of name values.\n// A no-op for the default node, specific nodes should implement this method.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceName() error {\n\treturn d.CheckInterfaceOverlap()\n}\n\n// CalculateInterfaceIndex parses the supplied interface name with the InterfaceRegexp.\n// Using the the port offset, it calculates the mapped interface index based on the InterfaceOffset\n// and the first data interface index.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error) {\n\tcaptureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(d.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, err\n\t}\n\n\tif parsedIndex, found := captureGroups[\"port\"]; found {\n\t\tparsedIndexInt, err := strconv.Atoi(parsedIndex)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"%q parsed index %q could not be cast to an integer\",\n\t\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\t\tparsedIndex,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcalculatedIndex := parsedIndexInt - d.InterfaceOffset + d.FirstDataIfIndex\n\t\treturn calculatedIndex, nil\n\t} else {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"%q does not have extracted interface index with regexp %q, 'port' capture group missing?\",\n\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\td.InterfaceRegexp,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}\n\n// GetMappedInterfaceName returns with a mapped interface name based on the mapped interface prefix\n// and calculated mapped interface index.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {\n\tifIndex, err := d.OverwriteNode.CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tif ifIndex < d.FirstDataIfIndex {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"extracted interface index for %q is out of bounds: %d ! >= %d\",\n\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\tifIndex,\n\t\t\td.FirstDataIfIndex,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\tmappedIfName := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s%d\", d.InterfaceMappedPrefix, ifIndex)\n\n\treturn mappedIfName, nil\n}\n\n// VerifyStartupConfig verifies that startup config files exists on disks.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) VerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error {\n\tcfg := d.Config().StartupConfig\n\tif cfg == \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\trcfg := clabutils.ResolvePath(cfg, topoDir)\n\tif !clabutils.FileExists(rcfg) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q startup-config file not found by the path %s\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), rcfg)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// GenerateConfig generates configuration for the nodes\n// out of the template `t` based on the node configuration and saves the result to dst.\n// If the config file is already present in the node dir we do not regenerate the config unless\n// EnforceStartupConfig is explicitly set to true and startup-config points to a file this will\n// persist the changes that users make to a running config when booted from some startup config.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GenerateConfig(dst, t string) error {\n\t// Check for incompatible options\n\tif d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {\n\t\treturn ErrIncompatibleOptions\n\t}\n\tif d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.StartupConfig == \"\" {\n\t\treturn ErrNoStartupConfig\n\t}\n\n\tif d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {\n\t\tlog.Info(\"Startup config generation suppressed\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif !d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && clabutils.FileExists(dst) {\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Existing config found\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName, \"path\", dst)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t} else {\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Generating config\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName, \"file\", d.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n\n\t\tcfgBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(strings.NewReader(t), d.Cfg)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Generated config\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName, \"content\", cfgBuf.String())\n\n\t\tf, err := os.Create(dst)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\t\t_, err = f.Write(cfgBuf.Bytes())\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// NodeOverwrites is an interface that every node implements.\n// It is used to enable DefaultNode to get access to the particular node structs\n// and is provided as an argument of the NewDefaultNode function.\n// The methods defined for this interfaces are the methods that particular node has a custom\n// implementation of.\ntype NodeOverwrites interface {\n\tVerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error\n\tCheckInterfaceName() error\n\tCalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error)\n\tGetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error)\n\tVerifyHostRequirements() error\n\tPullImage(ctx context.Context) error\n\tGetImages(ctx context.Context) map[string]string\n\tGetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error)\n\tGetContainerName() string\n\tGetContainerStatus(ctx context.Context) clabruntime.ContainerStatus\n\tVerifyContainerName() error\n\tVerifyLicenseFileExists(context.Context) error\n\tPreStop(context.Context) error\n\tRunExec(context.Context, *clabexec.ExecCmd) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error)\n\tGetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error)\n}\n\n// LoadStartupConfigFileVr templates a startup-config using the file specified for VM-based nodes in\n// the topo\n// and puts the resulting config file by the LabDir/configDirName/startupCfgFName path.\nfunc LoadStartupConfigFileVr(node Node, configDirName, startupCfgFName string) error {\n\tnodeCfg := node.Config()\n\t// create config directory that will be bind mounted to vrnetlab container at / path\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\n\tif nodeCfg.StartupConfig != \"\" {\n\t\t// dstCfg is a path to a file on the clab host that will have rendered configuration\n\t\tdstCfg := filepath.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName, startupCfgFName)\n\n\t\tc, err := os.ReadFile(nodeCfg.StartupConfig)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcfgTemplate := string(c)\n\n\t\terr = node.GenerateConfig(dstCfg, cfgTemplate)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"node=%s, failed to generate config: %v\", nodeCfg.ShortName, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// GetContainerName returns the name used by the runtime to identify the container\n// e.g. ext-container nodes use the name as defined in the topo file, while most other containers\n// use long (prefixed) name.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetContainerName() string {\n\treturn d.Cfg.LongName\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) VerifyContainerName() error {\n\tcontainerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()\n\tif !containerNamePatternRe.MatchString(containerName) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"Node name contains invalid characters: %s\", containerName)\n\t}\n\n\tif len(containerName) > maxNameLength {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\n\t\t\t\"Node name will not resolve via DNS\",\n\t\t\t\"name\",\n\t\t\tcontainerName,\n\t\t\t\"reason\",\n\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"name exceeds %d characters\", maxNameLength),\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\tif strings.ContainsAny(containerName, dnsIncompatibleChars) {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\n\t\t\t\"Node name will not resolve via DNS\",\n\t\t\t\"name\",\n\t\t\tcontainerName,\n\t\t\t\"reason\",\n\t\t\t\"name contains invalid characters such as '.' and/or '_'\",\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// RunExec executes a single command for a node.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) RunExec(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\texecCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd,\n) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error) {\n\texecResult, err := d.GetRuntime().Exec(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"%s: failed to execute cmd: %q with error %v\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn execResult, nil\n}\n\n// RunExecNotWait executes a command for a node, and doesn't block waiting for the output.\n// Should be overridden if the nodes implementation differs.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) RunExecNotWait(ctx context.Context, execCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd) error {\n\terr := d.GetRuntime().ExecNotWait(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"%s: failed to execute cmd: %q with error %v\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// VerifyLicenseFileExists checks if a license file with a provided path exists.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) VerifyLicenseFileExists(_ context.Context) error {\n\tif d.Config().License == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch d.LicensePolicy {\n\t\t// if a license is required by the kind but not provided\n\t\tcase clabtypes.LicensePolicyRequired:\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Provide one via 'license' knob in the topology file\",\n\t\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\t\td.Cfg.Kind,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\tcase clabtypes.LicensePolicyWarn:\n\t\t\t// just warn when no license is provided\n\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\n\t\t\t\t\"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Make sure to provide it in some way (e.g. license knob or baked into image)\",\n\t\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\t\td.Cfg.Kind,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\tcase clabtypes.LicensePolicyNone:\n\t\t\t// license is not required\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"unknown license policy value %s for node %s kind %s\",\n\t\t\t\td.LicensePolicy, d.Config().ShortName, d.Cfg.Kind)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// if license is provided check path exists\n\trlic := clabutils.ResolvePath(d.Config().License, d.Cfg.LabDir)\n\tif !clabutils.FileExists(rlic) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"license file for node %q is not found by the path %s\",\n\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\trlic,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// LoadOrGenerateCertificate loads a certificate using a certificate storage provider\n// provided in certInfra or generates a new one if it does not exist.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) LoadOrGenerateCertificate(\n\tcertInfra *clabcert.Cert,\n\ttopoName string,\n) (nodeCert *clabcert.Certificate, err error) {\n\t// early return if certificate generation is not required\n\tif d.Cfg.Certificate == nil || !*d.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\n\tnodeConfig := d.Cfg\n\n\t// try loading existing certificates from disk and generate new ones if they do not exist\n\tnodeCert, err = certInfra.LoadNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\"creating node certificate for %s\", nodeConfig.ShortName)\n\n\t\thosts := []string{\n\t\t\tnodeConfig.ShortName,\n\t\t\tnodeConfig.LongName,\n\t\t\tnodeConfig.ShortName + \".\" + topoName + \".io\",\n\t\t}\n\t\t// add the SANs provided via config\n\t\thosts = append(hosts, nodeConfig.Certificate.SANs...)\n\n\t\t// add mgmt IPs as SANs to CSR\n\t\tfor _, ip := range []string{d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address, d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address} {\n\t\t\tif ip != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\thosts = append(hosts, ip)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcertInput := &clabcert.NodeCSRInput{\n\t\t\tCommonName:   nodeConfig.ShortName + \".\" + topoName + \".io\",\n\t\t\tHosts:        hosts,\n\t\t\tOrganization: \"containerlab\",\n\t\t\tCountry:      \"US\",\n\t\t\tKeySize:      d.Cfg.Certificate.KeySize,\n\t\t\tExpiry:       d.Cfg.Certificate.ValidityDuration,\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Generate the cert for the node\n\t\tnodeCert, err = certInfra.GenerateAndSignNodeCert(certInput)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// persist the cert via certStorage\n\t\terr = certInfra.StoreNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName, nodeCert)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nodeCert, nil\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetHostsEntries(ctx context.Context) (clabtypes.HostEntries, error) {\n\tcontainers, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tresult := clabtypes.HostEntries{}\n\n\tfor idx := range containers {\n\t\tif len(containers[idx].Names) == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr != \"\" {\n\t\t\tresult = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(\n\t\t\t\tcontainers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr,\n\t\t\t\tcontainers[idx].Names[0],\n\t\t\t\tclabtypes.IpVersionV4,\n\t\t\t).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf(\"Kind: %s\", d.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(containers[idx].ID))\n\t\t}\n\t\tif containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr != \"\" {\n\t\t\tresult = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(\n\t\t\t\tcontainers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr,\n\t\t\t\tcontainers[idx].Names[0],\n\t\t\t\tclabtypes.IpVersionV6,\n\t\t\t).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf(\"Kind: %s\", d.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(containers[idx].ID))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn result, nil\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) AddLinkToContainer(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tlink netlink.Link,\n\tf func(ns.NetNS) error,\n) error {\n\tif !d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {\n\t\tst := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)\n\t\tif !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(st) {\n\t\t\tif st == clabruntime.Stopped {\n\t\t\t\tcontainerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()\n\t\t\t\td.GetRuntime().LogNonRunningContainerOutput(ctx, containerName)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"node %q: cannot attach link, container network namespace is not available (status=%s)\",\n\t\t\t\td.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t\tst,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// retrieve nodes nspath\n\tnsp, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetNSPath(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// retrieve the namespace handle\n\tnetns, err := ns.GetNS(nsp)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// move veth endpoint to namespace\n\tif err := netlink.LinkSetNsFd(link, int(netns.Fd())); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// execute the given function\n\terr = netns.Do(f)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Now, an important observation: `core/topology_reconcile.go` line 731 checks `topo.GetNodeLabels(nodeName)[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"`. And `core/tailscale.go` — the srl netns node's labels set InternalNode=true, good, similar to sros.

But wait: the srl netns node's labels are set on the *holder* container config only (newNetnsConfig clones n.Cfg.Labels and adds labels). The srl node itself doesn't get InternalNode label — good.

Now, key question for reconcile/restore: `core/topology_reconcile.go` — how does the reconcile flow treat the srl node with the netnsNode? Let me read that file, particularly around node enumeration and restore.

Also, how does `destroy` enumerate containers? cmd/inspect.go line 449: "if !o.Destroy.All && containers[idx].Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == 'true'" — filters internal nodes from destroy list unless --all. But destroy then re-instantiates nodes from the topology file and calls node.Delete... Actually the destroy flow: it loads the lab from the topology file (parsed from topology file, or from auto-generated clab file in lab dir). The srl node's Init will create the netnsNode (if config loaded from file has the labels?). Hmm — when destroy re-parses the topology, does the saved labels include InternalNode? Let's think about how destroy works: `Destroy` loads the topology and creates nodes; srl.Init creates netnsNode; then Destroy calls node.Delete which deletes both containers. So destroy works.

But what about `clab destroy --cleanup` in the test: "Verify no lab containers are left after destroy" — checks no containers with label containerlab=lab-name remain. The holder has the containerlab label (cloned) so it would be caught if left. OK.

Now the critical reconcile path: `core/topology_reconcile.go` — this is a new-ish feature that compares the deployed state with the topology and restarts/recreates nodes. Let me read it, especially how it collects containers for nodes and whether the srl netns node could confuse it.

122: // networkModeContainerTarget returns the referenced node name for a
123: // "network-mode: container:<name>" config, or "" if networkMode does not
124: // share another container's network namespace.
125: func networkModeContainerTarget(networkMode string) string {
126: 	if target, shared := strings.CutPrefix(networkMode, "container:"); shared {
127: 		return target
128: 	}
129: 	return ""
130: }

132: // checkApplyNetworkModeTargets rejects apply when a node's network-mode:
133: // container:<target> target is being removed from the topology while the
134: // dependent node stays desired. Deleting the target would leave the
135: // dependent silently attached to a defunct network namespace.
136: func (c *CLab) checkApplyNetworkModeTargets(plan *applyPlan) error {
137: 	if plan == nil {
138: 		return nil
139: 	}
140: 
141: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
142: 		networkMode := c.Nodes[nodeName].Config().NetworkMode
143: 		target := networkModeContainerTarget(networkMode)
144: 		if target == "" {
145: 			continue
146: 		}
147: 		if _, deleted := plan.deletedNodeSet[target]; deleted {
148: 			return fmt.Errorf(
149: 				"node %q has network-mode %q, but %q is being removed from the topology; "+
150: 					"remove or retarget %q as well",
151: 				nodeName,
152: 				networkMode,
153: 				target,
154: 				nodeName,
155: 			)
156: 		}
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return nil
160: }
161: 
162: // planNetworkModeCascade forces recreation of nodes whose network-mode:
163: // container:<target> target is itself being recreated. Docker binds
164: // NetworkMode to the target container's ID at creation time, so a plain
165: // restart of the dependent cannot rebind it to the target's new container;
166: // only recreating the dependent does. A reverse dependency graph visits each
167: // node and dependency at most once, including long namespace-sharing chains.
168: func (c *CLab) planNetworkModeCascade(plan *applyPlan) {
169: 	if plan == nil || len(plan.recreatedNodeSet) == 0 {
170: 		return
171: 	}
172: 
173: 	dependents := make(map[string][]string)
174: 	for name, node := range c.Nodes {
175: 		if target := networkModeContainerTarget(node.Config().NetworkMode); target != "" {
176: 			dependents[target] = append(dependents[target], name)
177: 		}
178: 	}
179: 	queue := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))
180: 	for name := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
181: 		queue = append(queue, name)
182: 	}
183: 	for i := 0; i < len(queue); i++ {
184: 		target := queue[i]
185: 		for _, nodeName := range dependents[target] {
186: 			if _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreated {
187: 				continue
188: 			}
189: 			if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
190: 				continue
191: 			}
192: 
193: 			plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
194: 			delete(plan.restartNodeSet, nodeName)
195: 			delete(plan.linkRestartNodeSet, nodeName)
196: 			plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = fmt.Sprintf(
197: 				"network-mode target %q recreated", target,
198: 			)
199: 			queue = append(queue, nodeName)
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: }

444: 		}
445: 	}
446: 
447: 	c.addDerivedHostStaleEndpoints(plan, plannedEndpointSet, key)
448: }
449: 
450: func (c *CLab) addDerivedHostStaleEndpoints(
451: 	plan *applyPlan,
452: 	plannedEndpointSet map[applyEndpointKey]struct{},
453: 	key applyEndpointKey,
454: ) {
455: 	if key.node == "host" {
456: 		return
457: 	}
458: 	if _, exists := c.Nodes[key.node]; !exists {
459: 		return
460: 	}
461: 
462: 	hostNode, exists := c.applyLinkNode("host")
463: 	if !exists {
464: 		return
465: 	}
466: 
467: 	for _, iface := range []string{
468: 		fmt.Sprintf("ve-%s_%s", key.node, key.iface),
469: 		fmt.Sprintf("vx-%s_%s", key.node, key.iface),
470: 	} {
471: 		hostKey := applyEndpointKey{node: "host", iface: iface}
472: 		if _, planned := plannedEndpointSet[hostKey]; planned {
473: 			continue
474: 		}
475: 		if _, desired := plan.desiredEndpointSet[hostKey]; desired {
476: 			continue
477: 		}
478: 
479: 		plannedEndpointSet[hostKey] = struct{}{}
480: 		plan.staleEndpoints = append(
481: 			plan.staleEndpoints,
482: 			applyEndpointRef{key: hostKey, node: hostNode, bestEffort: true},
483: 		)
484: 	}
485: }
486: 
487: func (c *CLab) discoverLiveApplyEndpoints(
488: 	ctx context.Context,
489: 	plan *applyPlan,
490: ) error {
491: 	desiredNodes := c.applyEndpointDiscoveryNodes(plan)
492: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedLinkNodeNames(desiredNodes) {
493: 		n := desiredNodes[nodeName]
494: 		if _, exists := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]; !exists && !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) {
495: 			continue
496: 		}
497: 
498: 		if _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {
499: 			if _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; !parked {
500: 				continue
501: 			}
502: 		}
503: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
504: 			if _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; !parked {
505: 				continue
506: 			}
507: 		}
508: 		if _, start := plan.startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {
509: 			parkingNode, ok := c.applyParkingLinkNode(nodeName)
510: 			if !ok {
511: 				continue
512: 			}
513: 			n = parkingNode
514: 		} else if !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) && !plan.isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName) {
515: 			status := c.Nodes[nodeName].GetContainerStatus(ctx)
516: 			if !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(status) {
517: 				if plan.isExternallyManaged(nodeName) {
518: 					return fmt.Errorf(
519: 						"externally managed node %q is %s; "+
520: 							"start it outside containerlab before running apply",
521: 						nodeName,
522: 						status,
523: 					)
524: 				}
525: 				return fmt.Errorf(
526: 					"node %q is %s; apply requires existing nodes to have a joinable network namespace",
527: 					nodeName,
528: 					status,
529: 				)
530: 			}
531: 		}
532: 
533: 		plan.setEndpointNode(nodeName, n)
534: 
535: 		interfaces, err := clablinks.DiscoverOwnedInterfacesFor(
536: 			ctx,
537: 			n,
538: 			nodeName,
539: 			c.applyKnownEndpointNames(plan, nodeName),
540: 		)
541: 		if err != nil {
542: 			return fmt.Errorf(
543: 				"failed to discover runtime interfaces for node %q: %w",
544: 				nodeName,
545: 				err,
546: 			)
547: 		}
548: 
549: 		for _, iface := range interfaces {
550: 			key := applyEndpointKey{node: nodeName, iface: iface.Name}
551: 			plan.liveEndpointSet[key] = struct{}{}
552: 			plan.liveEndpointInfo[key] = iface
553: 		}
554: 	}
555: 
556: 	return nil
557: }
558: 
559: func (c *CLab) validateDesiredEndpointOwnership(
560: 	ctx context.Context,
561: 	plan *applyPlan,
562: ) error {
563: 	for _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.desiredEndpointSet) {
564: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[key.node]; added {
565: 			continue
566: 		}
567: 
568: 		node, exists := plan.endpointNode(key.node)
569: 		if !exists {
570: 			node, exists = c.applyLinkNode(key.node)
571: 		}
572: 		if !exists {
573: 			continue
574: 		}
575: 
576: 		if err := clablinks.ValidateOwnedInterfaceFor(
577: 			ctx,
578: 			node,
579: 			key.node,
580: 			key.iface,
581: 		); err != nil {
582: 			return fmt.Errorf(
583: 				"desired endpoint %s cannot be reconciled: %w",
584: 				key.String(),
585: 				err,
586: 			)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 
590: 	return nil
591: }
592: 
593: func (c *CLab) applyParkingLinkNode(nodeName string) (clablinks.Node, bool) {
594: 	node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
595: 	if !exists || node.Config() == nil || node.Config().LongName == "" {
596: 		return nil, false
597: 	}
598: 
599: 	parkPath, err := clabutils.GetNamedNetNS(
600: 		clabutils.ParkingNetnsName(node.Config().LongName),
601: 	)
602: 	if err != nil {
603: 		return nil, false
604: 	}
605: 
606: 	return clablinks.NewParkingNode(node.Config().LongName, parkPath), true
607: }

609: func (c *CLab) applyKnownEndpointNames(
610: 	plan *applyPlan,
611: 	nodeName string,
612: ) map[string]struct{} {
613: 	if !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) {
614: 		return nil
615: 	}
616: 
617: 	names := map[string]struct{}{}
618: 	for key := range plan.desiredEndpointSet {
619: 		if key.node == nodeName {
620: 			names[key.iface] = struct{}{}
621: 		}
622: 	}
623: 
624: 	return names
625: }

627: func (c *CLab) applyEndpointDiscoveryNodes(plan *applyPlan) map[string]clablinks.Node {
628: 	nodes := make(map[string]clablinks.Node, len(c.Nodes)+2)
629: 	for nodeName, node := range c.Nodes {
630: 		nodes[nodeName] = node
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	for _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.desiredEndpointSet) {
634: 		if _, exists := nodes[key.node]; exists {
635: 			continue
636: 		}
637: 		if node, exists := c.applyLinkNode(key.node); exists {
638: 			nodes[key.node] = node
639: 		}
640: 	}
641: 
642: 	return nodes
643: }
644: 
645: func (c *CLab) applyLinkNode(nodeName string) (clablinks.Node, bool) {
646: 	if node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]; exists {
647: 		return node, true
648: 	}
649: 	node, exists := c.getSpecialLinkNodes()[nodeName]
650: 	return node, exists
651: }
652: 
653: func isApplySpecialNode(nodeName string) bool {
654: 	return nodeName == "host" || nodeName == "mgmt-net"
655: }
656: 
657: func (c *CLab) planAffectedApplyNode(
658: 	ctx context.Context,
659: 	plan *applyPlan,
660: 	nodeName string,
661: 	change string,
662: ) {
663: 	if nodeName == "" {
664: 		return
665: 	}
666: 	if _, planned := plan.linkRestartNodeSet[nodeName]; planned {
667: 		return
668: 	}
669: 	if _, planned := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; planned {
670: 		return
671: 	}
672: 
673: 	node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
674: 	if !exists {
675: 		return
676: 	}
677: 	if plan.isExternallyManaged(nodeName) {
678: 		log.Info(
679: 			"Applying link change without node lifecycle action",
680: 			"node", nodeName,
681: 			"change", change,
682: 			"externally-managed", true,
683: 		)
684: 		return
685: 	}
686: 
687: 	overridden := clabnodes.LinkApplyModeOverrideForNode(node) != ""
688: 
689: 	switch clabnodes.LinkApplyModeForNode(ctx, node) {
690: 	case clabnodes.LinkApplyModeLive:
691: 		log.Info(
692: 			"Applying link change without node lifecycle action",
693: 			"node",
694: 			nodeName,
695: 			"change",
696: 			change,
697: 		)
698: 	case clabnodes.LinkApplyModeRestart:
699: 		plan.linkRestartNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
700: 		plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = change
701: 		log.Info("Node will be restarted to apply link change", "node", nodeName, "change", change)
702: 	case clabnodes.LinkApplyModeRecreate:
703: 		plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
704: 		delete(plan.restartNodeSet, nodeName)
705: 		delete(plan.linkRestartNodeSet, nodeName)
706: 		plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = change
707: 
708: 		if overridden {
709: 			log.Info("Node will be recreated to apply link change",
710: 				"node", nodeName, "change", change, "link-apply-mode", "recreate")
711: 		} else {
712: 			log.Info(
713: 				"Node will be recreated to apply link change since its kind does not declare "+
714: 					"live link support; if the NOS detects hot-plugged interfaces, set "+
715: 					"link-apply-mode: live on the node to avoid the recreation",
716: 				"node", nodeName,
717: 				"change", change,
718: 			)
719: 		}
720: 	}
721: }

723: func (c *CLab) resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(
724: 	topo *clabtypes.Topology,
725: 	nodeName string,
726: ) *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
727: 	if topo == nil {
728: 		return nil
729: 	}
730: 	if topo.GetNodeKind(nodeName) == clabnodestailscale.KindName &&
731: 		topo.GetNodeLabels(nodeName)[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true" {
732: 		topo = &clabtypes.Topology{Nodes: map[string]*clabtypes.NodeDefinition{
733: 			nodeName: topo.Nodes[nodeName],
734: 		}}
735: 	}
736: 
737: 	binds, _ := topo.GetNodeBinds(nodeName)
738: 	portSet, _, _ := topo.GetNodePorts(nodeName)
739: 	kind := topo.GetNodeKind(nodeName)
740: 	privileged := topo.GetNodePrivileged(
741: 		nodeName,
742: 		c.privilegedByDefault(strings.ToLower(kind)),
743: 	)
744: 
745: 	nodeCfg := &clabtypes.NodeConfig{
746: 		ShortName:    nodeName,
747: 		Hostname:     topo.GetNodeHostname(nodeName),
748: 		Kind:         kind,
749: 		NodeType:     topo.GetNodeType(nodeName),
750: 		Image:        topo.GetNodeImage(nodeName),
751: 		Entrypoint:   topo.GetNodeEntrypoint(nodeName),
752: 		Cmd:          topo.GetNodeCmd(nodeName),
753: 		Exec:         topo.GetNodeExec(nodeName),
754: 		Env:          topo.GetNodeEnv(nodeName),
755: 		Binds:        binds,
756: 		Devices:      topo.GetNodeDevices(nodeName),
757: 		CapAdd:       topo.GetNodeCapAdd(nodeName),
758: 		Privileged:   privileged,
759: 		CgroupnsMode: topo.GetNodeCgroupnsMode(nodeName),
760: 		CgroupParent: topo.GetNodeCgroupParent(nodeName),
761: 		PidMode:      topo.GetNodePidMode(nodeName),
762: 		Tmpfs:        topo.GetNodeTmpfs(nodeName),
763: 		SecurityOpts: topo.GetNodeSecurityOpts(nodeName),
764: 		ShmSize:      topo.GetNodeShmSize(nodeName),
765: 		PortSet:      portSet,
766: 		User:         topo.GetNodeUser(nodeName),
767: 		NetworkMode:  topo.GetNodeNetworkMode(nodeName),
768: 		MgmtNet:      topo.GetNodeMgmtNet(nodeName),
769: 		Runtime:      topo.GetNodeRuntime(nodeName),
770: 		CPU:          topo.GetNodeCPU(nodeName),
771: 		CPUSet:       topo.GetNodeCPUSet(nodeName),
772: 		Memory:       topo.GetNodeMemory(nodeName),
773: 		License:      topo.GetNodeLicense(nodeName),
774: 	}
775: 
776: 	kindSpecificConfig, err := c.decodeKindSpecificConfig(topo, nodeName, strings.ToLower(kind))
777: 	if err != nil {
778: 		// A state file can hold keys a later release rejects; such a node counts as changed.
779: 		kindSpecificConfig = clabnodes.InvalidKindSpecificConfig{Err: err.Error()}
780: 	}
781: 
782: 	nodeCfg.KindSpecificConfig = kindSpecificConfig
783: 
784: 	return nodeCfg
785: }
786: 
787: func (c *CLab) planNodeReconciliation(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
788: 	if plan == nil || plan.currentNodes == nil {
789: 		return nil
790: 	}
791: 
792: 	var oldTopo *clabtypes.Topology
793: 	if plan.state != nil {
794: 		oldTopo = plan.state.Topology
795: 	}
796: 
797: 	for nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {
798: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
799: 		if !exists {
800: 			continue
801: 		}
802: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
803: 			continue
804: 		}
805: 
806: 		oldNodeConfig := c.resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(oldTopo, nodeName)
807: 		newNodeConfig := c.resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(c.Config.Topology, nodeName)
808: 		diff := node.ComputeDiff(oldNodeConfig, newNodeConfig)
809: 		plan.nodeDiffs[nodeName] = diff
810: 
811: 		result, err := node.GetReconcilePlan(ctx, diff)
812: 		if err != nil {
813: 			return fmt.Errorf("reconcile planning failed for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
814: 		}
815: 		if plan.isNonContainerNode(nodeName) && result.Action != clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {
816: 			return fmt.Errorf(
817: 				"node %q is externally managed and cannot be %s for %s",
818: 				nodeName,
819: 				result.Action,
820: 				configDriftReason(diff),
821: 			)
822: 		}
823: 
824: 		switch result.Action {
825: 		case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
826: 			plan.restartNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
827: 			plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = configDriftReason(diff)
828: 		case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
829: 			plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
830: 			plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = configDriftReason(diff)
831: 		}
832: 	}
833: 
834: 	return nil
835: }
836: 
837: func configDriftReason(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) string {
838: 	if diff == nil || len(diff.Fields) == 0 {
839: 		return "config drift"
840: 	}
841: 
842: 	return "config drift: " + strings.Join(diff.Fields, ", ")
843: }
844: 
845: func (c *CLab) reconcileNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
846: 	if plan == nil || plan.currentNodes == nil {
847: 		return nil
848: 	}
849: 
850: 	for nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {
851: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
852: 		if !exists {
853: 			continue
854: 		}
855: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
856: 			continue
857: 		}
858: 		if plan.isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName) {
859: 			continue
860: 		}
861: 		// Recreated nodes are handled exclusively by the apply pipeline
862: 		// (park -> delete -> deploy -> restore). Calling Reconcile here would
863: 		// delete the container before parkRecreatedNodes can capture its
864: 		// interfaces, breaking the recreate flow.
865: 		if _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreated {
866: 			continue
867: 		}
868: 
869: 		diff := plan.nodeDiffs[nodeName]
870: 
871: 		result, err := node.Reconcile(ctx, diff)
872: 		if err != nil {
873: 			return fmt.Errorf("reconcile failed for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
874: 		}
875: 
876: 		if result.Action == clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart {
877: 			if err := c.waitNodeRunning(ctx, node); err != nil {
878: 				return err
879: 			}
880: 			if err := c.waitNodeHealthyIfAvailable(ctx, node); err != nil {
881: 				return err
882: 			}
883: 		}
884: 	}
885: 
886: 	return nil
887: }
888: 
889: func (p *applyPlan) linkNeedsDeploy(link clablinks.Link) bool {
890: 	for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
891: 		key := endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep)
892: 		if _, parked := p.parkedNodeSet[key.node]; !parked {
893: 			if _, added := p.addedNodeSet[key.node]; added {
894: 				return true
895: 			}
896: 		}
897: 		if _, live := p.liveEndpointSet[key]; !live {
898: 			return true
899: 		}
900: 	}
901: 
902: 	return !p.linkIntact(link)
903: }
904: 
905: func (p *applyPlan) linkIntact(link clablinks.Link) bool {
906: 	endpoints := clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link)
907: 	if len(endpoints) != 2 || len(p.liveEndpointInfo) == 0 {
908: 		return true
909: 	}
910: 
911: 	left, leftOK := p.liveEndpointInfo[endpointKeyFromEndpoint(endpoints[0])]
912: 	right, rightOK := p.liveEndpointInfo[endpointKeyFromEndpoint(endpoints[1])]
913: 	if !leftOK || !rightOK {
914: 		return false
915: 	}
916: 
917: 	if bridgeMasterMismatch(endpoints[0], left) || bridgeMasterMismatch(endpoints[1], right) {
918: 		return false
919: 	}
920: 
921: 	return left.PeerIndex != 0 &&
922: 		right.PeerIndex != 0 &&
923: 		left.PeerIndex == right.Index &&
924: 		right.PeerIndex == left.Index
925: }
926: 
927: // bridgeMasterMismatch reports whether the live interface of a bridge endpoint is
928: // attached to a bridge other than the one the endpoint resolves to, e.g. after a
929: // mgmt-net link moved to another management network. mgmt-net endpoints whose
930: // management network bridge is not resolved are not checked.
931: func bridgeMasterMismatch(ep clablinks.Endpoint, live clablinks.OwnedInterface) bool {
932: 	node := ep.GetNode()
933: 	if node.GetLinkEndpointType() != clablinks.LinkEndpointTypeBridge ||
934: 		clablinks.IsUnresolvedMgmtBridgeEndpoint(ep) {
935: 		return false
936: 	}
937: 
938: 	return live.MasterName != node.GetShortName()
939: }
940: 
941: func (p *applyPlan) deployNodeNames() []string {
942: 	if p == nil {
943: 		return nil
944: 	}
945: 
946: 	nodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(p.addedNodeSet)+len(p.recreatedNodeSet))
947: 
948: 	for nodeName := range p.addedNodeSet {
949: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
950: 	}
951: 	for nodeName := range p.recreatedNodeSet {
952: 		if _, added := p.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; !added {
953: 			nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
954: 		}
955: 	}
956: 
957: 	sort.Strings(nodeNames)
958: 	return nodeNames
959: }
960: 
961: func (c *CLab) deleteApplyEndpoints(
962: 	ctx context.Context,
963: 	refs []applyEndpointRef,
964: ) error {
965: 	for _, ref := range refs {
966: 		log.Info("Deleting link endpoint", "endpoint", ref.key.String())
967: 		if err := clablinks.RemoveOwnedInterface(ctx, ref.node, ref.key.iface); err != nil {
968: 			if ref.bestEffort && errors.Is(err, clablinks.ErrInterfaceUnowned) {
969: 				log.Debugf("skipping best-effort endpoint delete: %v", err)
970: 				continue
971: 			}
972: 			return err
973: 		}
974: 	}
975: 
976: 	return nil
977: }

979: func (p *applyPlan) setEndpointNode(nodeName string, node clablinks.Node) {
980: 	if nodeName == "" || node == nil {
981: 		return
982: 	}
983: 	p.endpointNodes[nodeName] = node
984: }

986: func (p *applyPlan) endpointNode(nodeName string) (clablinks.Node, bool) {
987: 	node, ok := p.endpointNodes[nodeName]
988: 	return node, ok
989: }

991: func endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep clablinks.Endpoint) applyEndpointKey {
992: 	if ep == nil || ep.GetNode() == nil {
993: 		return applyEndpointKey{}
994: 	}
995: 	nodeName := ep.GetNode().GetShortName()
996: 	if ep.IsNodeless() && ep.GetNode().GetLinkEndpointType() == clablinks.LinkEndpointTypeBridge {
997: 		nodeName = "mgmt-net"
998: 	}
999: 	return applyEndpointKey{
1000: 		node:  nodeName,
1001: 		iface: ep.GetIfaceName(),
1002: 	}
1003: }
1004: 
1005: func applyLinkName(link clablinks.Link) string {
1006: 	endpoints := clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link)
1007: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(endpoints))
1008: 	for _, ep := range endpoints {
1009: 		key := endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep)
1010: 		if key.node == "" || key.iface == "" {
1011: 			continue
1012: 		}
1013: 		names = append(names, key.String())
1014: 	}
1015: 	sort.Strings(names)
1016: 
1017: 	return strings.Join(names, " -- ")
1018: }
1019: 
1020: func applyLinkNames(links []clablinks.Link) []string {
1021: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(links))
1022: 	for _, link := range links {
1023: 		names = append(names, applyLinkName(link))
1024: 	}
1025: 	return names
1026: }

1028: func applyDeletedEndpointNames(refs []applyEndpointRef) []string {
1029: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(refs))
1030: 	for _, ref := range refs {
1031: 		if ref.bestEffort {
1032: 			continue
1033: 		}
1034: 		names = append(names, ref.key.String())
1035: 	}
1036: 	return names
1037: }

1039: func sortedNodeNames(nodes map[string]clabnodes.Node) []string {
1040: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(nodes))
1041: 	for name := range nodes {
1042: 		names = append(names, name)
1043: 	}
1044: 	sort.Strings(names)
1045: 	return names
1046: }
1047: 
1048: func sortedLinkNodeNames(nodes map[string]clablinks.Node) []string {
1049: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(nodes))
1050: 	for name := range nodes {
1051: 		names = append(names, name)
1052: 	}
1053: 	sort.Strings(names)
1054: 	return names
1055: }
1056: 
1057: func sortedLinkIndexes(links map[int]clablinks.Link) []int {
1058: 	indexes := make([]int, 0, len(links))
1059: 	for idx := range links {
1060: 		indexes = append(indexes, idx)

229: 	if aOrder != bOrder {
230: 		return aOrder < bOrder
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	return aName < bName
234: }
235: 
236: func runtimeComponentSortOrder(name string) int {
237: 	idx := strings.LastIndex(name, "-")
238: 	if idx < 0 || idx == len(name)-1 {
239: 		return 0
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	slot := strings.ToUpper(name[idx+1:])
243: 	if len(slot) == 1 && slot[0] >= 'A' && slot[0] <= 'Z' {
244: 		return 100 - int(slot[0])
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	var n int
248: 	for _, r := range slot {
249: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
250: 			return 0
251: 		}
252: 		n = n*10 + int(r-'0')
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	return n
256: }

39: // Nodes with a user-defined network mode keep the network namespace of their own container.

41: 	return n.Cfg.NetworkMode == "" && !n.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased

89: 		Env:                   map[string]string{},
90: 		PortBindings:          n.Cfg.PortBindings,
91: 		PortSet:               n.Cfg.PortSet,
92: 		MgmtNet:               n.Cfg.MgmtNet,
93: 		MgmtIntf:              n.Cfg.MgmtIntf,
94: 		MgmtIPv4Address:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address,
95: 		MgmtIPv4AddressAuto:   n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto,
96: 		MgmtIPv4PrefixLength:  n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength,
97: 		MgmtIPv6Address:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address,
98: 		MgmtIPv6AddressAuto:   n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto,
99: 		MgmtIPv6PrefixLength:  n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength,
100: 		MgmtIPv4Gateway:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway,
101: 		MgmtIPv6Gateway:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway,
102: 		MacAddress:            n.Cfg.MacAddress,
103: 		Aliases:               n.Cfg.Aliases,
104: 		DNS:                   n.Cfg.DNS,
105: 		ExtraHosts:            n.Cfg.ExtraHosts,
106: 		Labels:                labels,
107: 		Runtime:               n.Cfg.Runtime,
108: 		ResultingPortBindings: n.Cfg.ResultingPortBindings,
109: 	}
110: }
111: 
112: // containerConfig returns the config of the SR Linux container attached to the holder's
113: // network namespace. The runtime rejects network settings for such containers, as they
114: // belong to the holder.
115: func (n *srl) containerConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
116: 	cfg := *n.Cfg
117: 	cfg.NetworkMode = "container:" + n.netnsNode.GetShortName()
118: 	cfg.DNS = nil
119: 	cfg.ExtraHosts = nil
120: 	cfg.MacAddress = ""
121: 	cfg.PortBindings = nil
122: 	cfg.PortSet = nil
123: 
124: 	return &cfg
125: }
126: 
127: func (n *srl) ensureNetnsRunning(ctx context.Context) error {
128: 	switch status := n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {
129: 	case clabruntime.Running:
130: 	case clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:
131: 		if err := n.netnsNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {
132: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container start error: %w",
133: 				n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
134: 		}
135: 	case clabruntime.Paused:
136: 		if err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName); err != nil {
137: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w",
138: 				n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
139: 		}
140: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
141: 		return fmt.Errorf(
142: 			"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node",
143: 			n.Cfg.ShortName, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName,
144: 		)
145: 	default:
146: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container %q is %s",
147: 			n.Cfg.ShortName, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, status)
148: 	}
149: 
150: 	return nil
151: }
152: 
153: // linkNetns points the node's netns symlink to the holder, as the namespace path of the
154: // SR Linux container changes whenever the container restarts.
155: func (n *srl) linkNetns(ctx context.Context) error {
156: 	nsPath, err := n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
157: 	if err != nil {
158: 		return err
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	return clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)
162: }
163: 
164: func (n *srl) Deploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {
165: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
166: 		return n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, params)
167: 	}
168: 
169: 	// network settings are finalized after Init, so the holder config is rebuilt here.
170: 	*n.netnsNode.Config() = *n.newNetnsConfig()
171: 	if err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, params); err != nil {
172: 		return fmt.Errorf("deploy network namespace node %q: %w", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)
173: 	}
174: 
175: 	n.Cfg.Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(n.GetEndpoints()))
176: 
177: 	cID, err := n.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, n.containerConfig())
178: 	if err != nil {
179: 		return err
180: 	}
181: 
182: 	if _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, n); err != nil {
183: 		return err
184: 	}
185: 
186: 	if err := n.linkNetns(ctx); err != nil {
187: 		return err
188: 	}
189: 
190: 	n.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
191: 
192: 	return nil
193: }
194: 
195: func (n *srl) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
196: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
197: 		return n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx)
198: 	}
199: 
200: 	if err := n.ensureNetnsRunning(ctx); err != nil {
201: 		return err
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if err := n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {
205: 		return err
206: 	}
207: 
208: 	return n.linkNetns(ctx)
209: }
210: 
211: // Stop also stops the holder, so that the next start gets a fresh network namespace without
212: // interfaces left behind by the stopped SR Linux container.
213: func (n *srl) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
214: 	if err := n.DefaultNode.Stop(ctx); err != nil || n.netnsNode == nil {
215: 		return err
216: 	}
217: 
218: 	if n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) != clabruntime.Running {
219: 		return nil
220: 	}
221: 
222: 	return n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, n.netnsNode.StopSignal)
223: }
224: 
225: func (n *srl) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
226: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
227: 		return n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)
228: 	}
229: 
230: 	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))
231: }
232: 
233: // GetContainers returns the SR Linux container with the network settings of the holder.
234: // When only the holder exists, it is returned so that it is not orphaned on destroy.
235: func (n *srl) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
236: 	cnts, err := n.DefaultNode.GetContainers(ctx)
237: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
238: 		return cnts, err
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	if err != nil {
242: 		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
243: 			return n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		return nil, err
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	holder, err := n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
250: 	if err != nil {
251: 		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
252: 			return cnts, nil
253: 		}
254: 
255: 		return nil, err
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	cnts[0].NetworkName = holder[0].NetworkName
259: 	cnts[0].NetworkSettings = holder[0].NetworkSettings
260: 	cnts[0].Ports = holder[0].Ports
261: 
262: 	return cnts, nil
263: }
264: 
265: // GetNSPath retrieves the Namespace Path.
266: func (n *srl) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
267: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
268: 		return n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
269: 	}
270: 
271: 	return n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
272: }
273: 
274: // DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.
275: func (n *srl) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {
276: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
277: 		return n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink()
278: 	}
279: 
280: 	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink(), n.netnsNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())

The runtime rejects network settings for such containers, as they\n// belong to the holder.\nfunc (n *srl) containerConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {\n\tcfg := *n.Cfg\n\tcfg.NetworkMode = \"container:\" + n.netnsNode.GetShortName()\n\tcfg.DNS = nil\n\tcfg.ExtraHosts = nil\n\tcfg.MacAddress = \"\"\n\tcfg.PortBindings = nil\n\tcfg.PortSet = nil\n\n\treturn &cfg\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) ensureNetnsRunning(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tswitch status := n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n\t\t}\n\tcase clabruntime.NotFound:\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName,\n\t\t)\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q network namespace container %q is %s\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, status)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// linkNetns points the node's netns symlink to the holder, as the namespace path of the\n// SR Linux container changes whenever the container restarts.\nfunc (n *srl) linkNetns(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tnsPath, err := n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) Deploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, params)\n\t}\n\n\t// network settings are finalized after Init, so the holder config is rebuilt here.\n\t*n.netnsNode.Config() = *n.newNetnsConfig()\n\tif err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, params); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"deploy network namespace node %q: %w\", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)\n\t}\n\n\tn.Cfg.Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(n.GetEndpoints()))\n\n\tcID, err := n.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, n.containerConfig())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, n); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.linkNetns(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) Start(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.ensureNetnsRunning(ctx); 38: 		RestartedNodes:    []string{},
39: 		NodeChangeReasons: map[string]string{},
40: 	}
41: 	if plan == nil {
42: 		return result
43: 	}
44: 
45: 	result.AddedNodes = sortedStringSet(plan.addedNodeSet)
46: 	result.DeletedNodes = sortedStringSet(plan.deletedNodeSet)
47: 	result.RecreatedNodes = sortedStringSet(plan.recreatedNodeSet)
48: 	result.StartedNodes = sortedStringSet(plan.startNodeSet)
49: 	result.AddedLinks = applyLinkNames(plan.addedLinks)
50: 	result.DeletedEndpoints = applyDeletedEndpointNames(plan.staleEndpoints)
51: 	result.RestartedNodes = sortedStringSet(unionStringSets(
52: 		plan.restartNodeSet,
53: 		plan.linkRestartNodeSet,
54: 	))
55: 
56: 	for nodeName, reason := range plan.nodeChangeReasons {
57: 		result.NodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = reason
58: 	}
59: 
60: 	return result
61: }

63: // Apply deploys a lab if it is absent, otherwise it aligns the deployed lab with the
64: // desired topology using runtime state as baseline.
65: func (c *CLab) Apply(
66: 	ctx context.Context,
67: 	options *ApplyOptions,
68: ) (*ApplyResult, error) {
69: 	if options == nil {
70: 		var err error
71: 		options, err = NewApplyOptions(0)
72: 		if err != nil {
73: 			return nil, err
74: 		}
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	if c.Config.Name == "" {
78: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing lab name")
79: 	}
80: 	if !c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileIsSet() {
81: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
82: 			"apply requires a topology file; provide --topo when it cannot be derived from --name",
83: 		)
84: 	}
85: 
86: 	currentNodes, err := c.runtimeNodeGroups(ctx)
87: 	if err != nil {
88: 		return nil, err
89: 	}
90: 
91: 	return c.apply(ctx, options, currentNodes)
92: }
93: 
94: func (c *CLab) apply(
95: 	ctx context.Context,
96: 	options *ApplyOptions,
97: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
98: ) (*ApplyResult, error) {
99: 	initialDeploy, err := c.needsInitialDeploy(currentNodes)
100: 	if err != nil {
101: 		return nil, err
102: 	}
103: 	if initialDeploy {
104: 		result := &ApplyResult{
105: 			DryRun:      options.dryRun,
106: 			DeployedLab: true,
107: 			LabName:     c.Config.Name,
108: 		}
109: 
110: 		if options.dryRun {
111: 			return result, nil
112: 		}
113: 
114: 		deployOptions, err := NewDeployOptions(options.maxWorkers)
115: 		if err != nil {
116: 			return nil, err
117: 		}
118: 		deployOptions.SetSkipPostDeploy(options.skipPostDeploy).
119: 			SetSkipLabDirFileACLs(options.skipLabDirFileACLs).
120: 			SetGraph(options.graph).
121: 			SetExportTemplate(options.exportTemplate)
122: 
123: 		if _, err := c.deploy(ctx, deployOptions); err != nil {
124: 			return nil, err
125: 		}
126: 
127: 		return result, nil
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if err := c.setMgmtBridgeFromRuntime(currentNodes); err != nil {
131: 		return nil, err
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	if err := c.resolveMgmtNetLinkNetworks(ctx); err != nil {
135: 		return nil, err
136: 	}
137: 
138: 	if err := c.setMgmtNetLinkBridges(); err != nil {
139: 		return nil, err
140: 	}
141: 
142: 	if err := c.ResolveLinks(); err != nil {
143: 		return nil, err
144: 	}
145: 
146: 	if err := c.checkApplyTopologyDefinition(ctx); err != nil {
147: 		return nil, err
148: 	}
149: 
150: 	plan, err := c.planApply(ctx, currentNodes)
151: 	if err != nil {
152: 		return nil, err
153: 	}
154: 
155: 	if options.dryRun {
156: 		result := applyResultFromPlan(plan)
157: 		result.DryRun = true
158: 		return result, nil
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	if err := c.reconcileNodes(ctx, plan); err != nil {
162: 		return nil, err
163: 	}
164: 
165: 	if plan.empty() {
166: 		if c.tailscaleProxyEnabled() {
167: 			if err := c.updateRuntimeInfoForExistingNodes(ctx); err != nil {
168: 				return nil, err
169: 			}
170: 		}
171: 		if err := c.syncTailscaleProxy(ctx); err != nil {
172: 			return nil, err
173: 		}
174: 		if options.finalizeNoop {
175: 			if err := c.prepareApply(
176: 				ctx,
177: 				nil,
178: 				options.skipLabDirFileACLs,
179: 				currentNodes,
180: 			); err != nil {
181: 				return nil, err
182: 			}
183: 		}
184: 		if err := c.SyncMgmtHostRoutes(ctx); err != nil {
185: 			return nil, err
186: 		}
187: 		if options.finalizeNoop {
188: 			if _, err := c.finalize(ctx, options.exportTemplate, options.graph); err != nil {
189: 				return nil, err
190: 			}
191: 		} else {
192: 			c.writeState()
193: 		}
194: 		return applyResultFromPlan(plan), nil
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	deployNodeNames := plan.deployNodeNames()
198: 	if err := c.prepareApply(
199: 		ctx,
200: 		deployNodeNames,
201: 		options.skipLabDirFileACLs,
202: 		currentNodes,
203: 	); err != nil {
204: 		return nil, err
205: 	}
206: 
207: 	if err := c.deleteApplyEndpoints(ctx, plan.staleEndpoints); err != nil {
208: 		return nil, err
209: 	}
210: 
211: 	if err := c.parkRecreatedNodes(ctx, plan); err != nil {
212: 		return nil, err
213: 	}
214: 
215: 	if err := c.deleteApplyNodes(ctx, plan); err != nil {
216: 		return nil, err
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	if err := c.deployApplyNodes(ctx, plan, options.maxWorkers); err != nil {
220: 		return nil, err
221: 	}
222: 
223: 	if err := c.restoreRecreatedNodes(ctx, plan); err != nil {
224: 		return nil, err
225: 	}
226: 
227: 	if err := c.removeApplyLinkEndpoints(ctx, plan.addedLinks); err != nil {
228: 		return nil, err
229: 	}
230: 
231: 	if err := c.deployLinks(ctx, plan.addedLinks, deployNodeNames); err != nil {
232: 		return nil, err
233: 	}
234: 
235: 	if err := c.postDeployApplyNodes(ctx, deployNodeNames, options.skipPostDeploy); err != nil {
236: 		return nil, err
237: 	}
238: 
239: 	if err := c.restartApplyNodes(ctx, plan.linkRestartNodeSet); err != nil {
240: 		return nil, err
241: 	}
242: 
243: 	if err := c.updateRuntimeInfoForExistingNodes(ctx); err != nil {
244: 		return nil, err
245: 	}
246: 	if err := c.syncTailscaleProxy(ctx); err != nil {
247: 		return nil, err
248: 	}
249: 	if err := c.SyncMgmtHostRoutes(ctx); err != nil {
250: 		return nil, err
251: 	}
252: 
253: 	if _, err := c.finalize(ctx, options.exportTemplate, options.graph); err != nil {
254: 		return nil, err
255: 	}
256: 
257: 	return applyResultFromPlan(plan), nil
258: }
259: 
260: func (c *CLab) checkApplyTopologyDefinition(ctx context.Context) error {
261: 	params := *clablinks.NewVerifyLinkParams()
262: 	if len(c.Endpoints) > 0 {
263: 		runtime := c.globalRuntime()
264: 		if runtime == nil {
265: 			return fmt.Errorf("container runtime is not initialized")
266: 		}
267: 		config := runtime.Config()
268: 		if config.VerifyLinkParams != nil {
269: 			params = *config.VerifyLinkParams
270: 		}
271: 	}
272: 	params.AllowExistingEndpoint = true
273: 	if err := c.verifyLinks(ctx, &params); err != nil {
274: 		return err
275: 	}
276: 
277: 	if err := c.verifyRootNetNSLinks(); err != nil {
278: 		return err
279: 	}
280: 
281: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
282: 		if err := c.Nodes[nodeName].CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx); err != nil {
283: 			return err
284: 		}
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	if err := c.verifyDuplicateAddresses(); err != nil {
288: 		return err
289: 	}
290: 
291: 	return c.verifyTailscaleProxy()
292: }
293: 
294: func (c *CLab) prepareApply(
295: 	ctx context.Context,
296: 	addedNodes []string,
297: 	skipLabDirFileACLs bool,
298: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
299: ) error {
300: 	existing := c.collectExistingManagementAddresses(currentNodes)
301: 	if err := c.prepareLabManagementNetwork(ctx, existing...); err != nil {
302: 		return err
303: 	}
304: 
305: 	if err := c.prepareDeployArtifacts(ctx, skipLabDirFileACLs); err != nil {
306: 		return err
307: 	}
308: 
309: 	for _, nodeName := range addedNodes {
310: 		if err := c.Nodes[nodeName].PullImage(ctx); err != nil {
311: 			return err
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 
315: 	return nil
316: }
317: 
318: func (*CLab) removeApplyLinkEndpoints(ctx context.Context, links []clablinks.Link) error {
319: 	for _, link := range links {
320: 		for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
321: 			if err := clablinks.RemoveOwnedInterface(
322: 				ctx,
323: 				ep.GetNode(),
324: 				ep.GetIfaceName(),
325: 			); err != nil {
326: 				return err
327: 			}
328: 		}
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	return nil
332: }
333: 
334: // try to preserve the existing addressing instead of reallocation.
335: func (c *CLab) collectExistingManagementAddresses(
336: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
337: ) []clabtypes.ExistingAddress {
338: 	var existing []clabtypes.ExistingAddress
339: 	for name, group := range currentNodes {
340: 		for _, ctr := range group.containers {
341: 			if c.mgmtNetByNetwork(ctr.NetworkName).Network != ctr.NetworkName {
342: 				continue
343: 			}
344: 			for _, value := range []string{ctr.NetworkSettings.IPv4addr, ctr.NetworkSettings.IPv6addr} {
345: 				if ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(value); err == nil {
346: 					existing = append(
347: 						existing,
348: 						clabtypes.ExistingAddress{NodeName: name, ContainerID: ctr.ID, Address: ip},
349: 					)
350: 				}
351: 			}
352: 		}
353: 	}
354: 	return existing
355: }

132: 		return nil, err
133: 	}
134: 
135: 	if options.dryRun {
136: 		return &DeployResult{Apply: applyResult}, nil
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	containers, err := c.ListNodesContainers(ctx)
140: 	if err != nil {
141: 		return nil, err
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	return &DeployResult{Containers: containers, Apply: applyResult}, nil
145: }
146: 
147: // checkReconcileDeployOptions rejects deploy options that only make sense for a fresh
148: // deployment when deploy is about to reconcile an already deployed lab.
149: func (c *CLab) checkReconcileDeployOptions(options *DeployOptions) error {
150: 	if c.managementNetworkOverridden {
151: 		return fmt.Errorf(
152: 			"management network overrides require a fresh deployment, but lab %q is already "+
153: 				"deployed; use --reconfigure to destroy and redeploy it",
154: 			c.Config.Name,
155: 		)
156: 	}
157: 
158: 	if options.restoreAll != "" || len(options.restoreNodeSnapshots) > 0 {
159: 		return fmt.Errorf(
160: 			"snapshot restore requires a fresh deployment, but lab %q is already deployed; "+
161: 				"use --reconfigure to destroy and redeploy it",
162: 			c.Config.Name,
163: 		)
164: 	}
165: 
166: 	if len(c.nodeFilter) > 0 {
167: 		return fmt.Errorf(
168: 			"node filter is not supported when reconciling deployed lab %q: "+
169: 				"running nodes excluded by the filter would be deleted; "+
170: 				"remove the filter or use --reconfigure",
171: 			c.Config.Name,
172: 		)
173: 	}
174: 
175: 	return nil
176: }
177: 
178: // deploy creates a lab that has no managed runtime nodes yet.
179: // skipcq: GO-R1005
180: func (c *CLab) deploy( //nolint: funlen
181: 	ctx context.Context,
182: 	options *DeployOptions,
183: ) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
184: 	if c.LabRuntime != nil {
185: 		return c.deployWithLabRuntime(ctx, options)
186: 	}
187: 
188: 	var err error
189: 
190: 	err = c.ResolveLinks()
191: 	if err != nil {
192: 		return nil, err
193: 	}
194: 
195: 	log.Debugf("lab Conf: %+v", c.Config)
196: 
197: 	if options.reconfigure {
198: 		_ = c.destroy(ctx, uint(len(c.Nodes)), true)
199: 		log.Info("Removing directory", "path", c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir())
200: 
201: 		if err := os.RemoveAll(c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir()); err != nil {
202: 			return nil, err
203: 		}
204: 	}
205: 
206: 	err = c.prepareLabManagementNetwork(ctx)
207: 	if err != nil {
208: 		return nil, err
209: 	}
210: 
211: 	if err := c.checkTopologyDefinition(ctx); err != nil {
212: 		return nil, err
213: 	}
214: 
215: 	if err := c.prepareDeployArtifacts(ctx, options.skipLabDirFileACLs); err != nil {
216: 		return nil, err
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	// Apply snapshot restore configuration to nodes
220: 	if err := c.configureSnapshotRestore(options); err != nil {
221: 		return nil, err
222: 	}
223: 
224: 	nodesWg, execCollection, nodeFailCh, err := c.createNodes(
225: 		ctx,
226: 		options.maxWorkers,
227: 		options.skipPostDeploy,
228: 	)
229: 	if err != nil {
230: 		return nil, err
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	if err := waitForNodeDeploy(ctx, nodesWg, nodeFailCh); err != nil {
234: 		return nil, err
235: 	}
236: 	if err := c.syncTailscaleProxy(ctx); err != nil {
237: 		return nil, err
238: 	}
239: 	if err := c.SyncMgmtHostRoutes(ctx); err != nil {
240: 		return nil, err
241: 	}
242: 
243: 	// also call deploy on the special nodes endpoints (only host is required for the
244: 	// vxlan stitched endpoints).
245: 	// this must happen after all node workers have finished so that veth pairs created
246: 	// as part of vxlan-stitch links are already deployed before the stitch TC rules are applied.
247: 	eps := c.getSpecialLinkNodes()["host"].GetEndpoints()
248: 	for _, ep := range eps {
249: 		err = ep.Deploy(ctx)
250: 		if err != nil {
251: 			log.Warnf("failed deploying endpoint %s", ep)
252: 		}
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	// Stitch links after node workers and host endpoints have finished.
256: 	// The veth pair is already created by node workers and the VxLAN interface is created
257: 	// by host endpoint deploy; Stitch applies the TC redirect rules to bridge them.
258: 	var linkPostDeployWorkers errgroup.Group
259: 	linkPostDeployWorkers.SetLimit(int(options.maxWorkers))
260: 	for _, link := range c.Links {
261: 		linkPostDeployWorkers.Go(func() error {
262: 			if err := link.PostDeploy(ctx); err != nil {
263: 				log.Warnf("failed post-deploying link: %v", err)
264: 			}
265: 			return nil
266: 		})
267: 	}
268: 	_ = linkPostDeployWorkers.Wait()
269: 
270: 	execCollection.Log()
271: 
272: 	return c.finalize(ctx, options.exportTemplate, options.graph)
273: }
274: 
275: func waitForNodeDeploy(
276: 	ctx context.Context,
277: 	nodesWg *sync.WaitGroup,
278: 	nodeFailCh chan error,
279: ) error {
280: 	if nodesWg != nil {
281: 		nodesWg.Wait()
282: 	}
283: 
284: 	close(nodeFailCh)
285: 
286: 	// Cancellation takes precedence over errors caused by workers unwinding, and
287: 	// prevents post-deploy work from running against a partial lab.
288: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
289: 		return err
290: 	}
291: 
292: 	var nodeFailErrs []error
293: 	for nodeErr := range nodeFailCh {
294: 		nodeFailErrs = append(nodeFailErrs, nodeErr)
295: 	}
296: 	if len(nodeFailErrs) > 0 {
297: 		return fmt.Errorf(
298: 			"deployment failed for one or more nodes: %w",
299: 			errors.Join(nodeFailErrs...),
300: 		)
301: 	}
302: 
303: 	return nil
304: }
305: 
306: // prepareLabManagementNetwork creates the management networks that are in use
307: // and allocates addresses for the nodes attached to them.
308: func (c *CLab) prepareLabManagementNetwork(
309: 	ctx context.Context,
310: 	existing ...clabtypes.ExistingAddress,
311: ) error {
312: 	if err := c.CreateNetwork(ctx); err != nil {
313: 		return err
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	if err := c.allocateLabManagementIPs(ctx, existing); err != nil {
317: 		return err
318: 	}
319: 
320: 	return c.setMgmtNetLinkBridges()
321: }
322: 
323: func (c *CLab) allocateLabManagementIPs(
324: 	ctx context.Context,
325: 	existing []clabtypes.ExistingAddress,
326: ) error {
327: 	preferred := make(map[string]clabtypes.NodeAddresses)
328: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
329: 	if err != nil {
330: 		log.Warn("Ignoring preferred management addresses", "error", err)
331: 	}
332: 
333: 	if state != nil {
334: 		for name, addresses := range state.IPAM {
335: 			preferred[name] = addresses
336: 		}
337: 	}
338: 
339: 	for _, m := range c.allMgmtNetworks() {
340: 		if c.skipMgmtNetwork(m) {
341: 			continue
342: 		}
343: 		nodes := c.mgmtNetNodes(m)
344: 		if m.IPAM.Provider == clabtypes.IPAMProviderRuntime || len(nodes) == 0 {
345: 			continue
346: 		}
347: 
348: 		reserved, err := c.collectReservedManagementAddresses(ctx, m, existing)
349: 		if err != nil {
350: 			return err
351: 		}
352: 
353: 		err = mgmt.AllocateManagementIPs(
354: 			ctx,
355: 			m,
356: 			nodes,
357: 			clabtypes.AllocationOptions{
358: 				Existing:  existing,
359: 				Preferred: preferred,
360: 				Reserved:  reserved,
361: 			},
362: 		)
363: 		if err != nil {
364: 			return err
365: 		}
366: 	}
367: 
368: 	return nil
369: }
370: 
371: func (c *CLab) collectReservedManagementAddresses(
372: 	ctx context.Context,
373: 	m *clabtypes.MgmtNet,
374: 	existing []clabtypes.ExistingAddress,
375: ) ([]netip.Addr, error) {
376: 	var subnets []netip.Prefix
377: 	for _, value := range []string{m.IPv4Subnet, m.IPv6Subnet} {
378: 		if value == "" {
379: 			continue
380: 		}
381: 		subnet, err := netip.ParsePrefix(value)
382: 		if err != nil {
383: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("management subnet %q: %w", value, err)
384: 		}
385: 		subnets = append(subnets, subnet)
386: 	}
387: 	occupied, err := c.globalRuntime().NetworkAddresses(ctx, subnets)
388: 	if err != nil {
389: 		return nil, err
390: 	}
391: 	type ownerAddress struct {
392: 		containerID string
393: 		address     netip.Addr
394: 	}
395: 	reused := make(map[ownerAddress]bool, len(existing))
396: 	for _, entry := range existing {
397: 		if entry.ContainerID != "" {
398: 			reused[ownerAddress{entry.ContainerID, entry.Address}] = true
399: 		}
400: 	}
401: 
402: 	var reserved []netip.Addr
403: 	for _, entry := range occupied {
404: 		if entry.NetworkName == m.Network &&
405: 			reused[ownerAddress{entry.ContainerID, entry.Address}] {
406: 			continue
407: 		}
408: 		reserved = append(reserved, entry.Address)
409: 	}
410: 	return reserved, nil
411: }

414: 	if err := c.loadKernelModules(); err != nil {
415: 		return err
416: 	}

420: 	if err := c.createPlaceholderArtifacts(); err != nil {
421: 		return err
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	if err := c.setupNodeAuth(ctx); err != nil {
425: 		return err
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	c.populateExtraHosts()
429: 
430: 	return nil
431: }

434: 	log.Info("Creating lab directory", "path", c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir())
435: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir(), clabconstants.PermissionsDirDefault)

438: 		return

442: 		log.Infof("unable to adjust Labdir file ACLs: %v", err)
443: 	}

447: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(
448: 		c.TopoPaths.CABaseDir(),

452: 	paths := []string{

460: 			return err

464: 	return nil

490: func (c *CLab) populateExtraHosts() {
491: 	extraHosts := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))
492: 
493: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
494: 		n := c.Nodes[nodeName]
495: 		if n.Config().MgmtIPv4Address != "" {
496: 			log.Debugf("Adding static ipv4 /etc/hosts entry for %s:%s",
497: 				n.Config().ShortName, n.Config().MgmtIPv4Address)
498: 			extraHosts = append(extraHosts, n.Config().ShortName+":"+n.Config().MgmtIPv4Address)
499: 		}
500: 		if n.Config().MgmtIPv6Address != "" {
501: 			log.Debugf("Adding static ipv6 /etc/hosts entry for %s:%s",
502: 				n.Config().ShortName, n.Config().MgmtIPv6Address)
503: 			extraHosts = append(extraHosts, n.Config().ShortName+":"+n.Config().MgmtIPv6Address)
504: 		}
505: 	}
506: 
507: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
508: 		n := c.Nodes[nodeName]
509: 		if !strings.HasPrefix(n.Config().NetworkMode, "container:") {
510: 			n.Config().ExtraHosts = extraHosts
511: 		}
512: 	}
513: }
