515: // certificateAuthoritySetup sets up the certificate authority parameters.
516: func (c *CLab) certificateAuthoritySetup() error {
517: 	// init the Cert storage and CA
518: 	c.Cert.CertStorage = clabcert.NewLocalDirCertStorage(c.TopoPaths)
519: 	c.Cert.CA = clabcert.NewCA()
520: 
521: 	s := c.Config.Settings
522: 
523: 	// Set defaults for the CA parameters
524: 	keySize := 2048
525: 	validityDuration := time.Until(time.Now().AddDate(1, 0, 0)) // 1 year as default
526: 	var extCACert, extCAKey string
527: 
528: 	// check that Settings.CertificateAuthority exists.
529: 	if s != nil && s.CertificateAuthority != nil {
530: 		// if ValidityDuration is set use the value
531: 		if s.CertificateAuthority.ValidityDuration != 0 {
532: 			validityDuration = s.CertificateAuthority.ValidityDuration
533: 		}
534: 
535: 		// if KeyLength is set use the value
536: 		if s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize != 0 {
537: 			keySize = s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize
538: 		}
539: 
540: 		// if external CA cert and key are set, propagate to topopaths
541: 		extCACert = s.CertificateAuthority.Cert
542: 		extCAKey = s.CertificateAuthority.Key
543: 	}
544: 
545: 	// override external ca and key from env vars
546: 	if v := os.Getenv("CLAB_CA_KEY_FILE"); v != "" {
547: 		extCAKey = v
548: 	}
549: 
550: 	if v := os.Getenv("CLAB_CA_CERT_FILE"); v != "" {
551: 		extCACert = v
552: 	}
553: 
554: 	if extCACert != "" && extCAKey != "" {
555: 		err := c.TopoPaths.SetExternalCaFiles(extCACert, extCAKey)
556: 		if err != nil {
557: 			return err
558: 		}
559: 	}
560: 
561: 	// define the attributes used to generate the CA Cert
562: 	caCertInput := &clabcert.CACSRInput{
563: 		CommonName:   c.Config.Name + " lab CA",
564: 		Country:      "US",
565: 		Expiry:       validityDuration,
566: 		Organization: "containerlab",
567: 		KeySize:      keySize,
568: 	}
569: 
570: 	return c.LoadOrGenerateCA(caCertInput)
571: }
572: 
573: // createNodes schedules nodes creation and returns a waitgroup for all nodes
574: // with the exec collection created from the exec config of each node.
575: // The exec collection is returned to the caller to ensure that the execution log
576: // is printed after the nodes are created.
577: // Nodes interdependencies are created in this function.
578: func (c *CLab) createNodes(
579: 	ctx context.Context,
580: 	maxWorkers uint,
581: 	skipPostDeploy bool,
582: ) (*sync.WaitGroup, *clabexec.ExecCollection, chan error, error) {
583: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
584: 		c.dependencyManager.AddNode(node)
585: 	}
586: 
587: 	// nodes with static mgmt IP should be scheduled before the dynamic ones
588: 	err := c.createStaticDynamicDependency()
589: 	if err != nil {
590: 		return nil, nil, nil, err
591: 	}
592: 
593: 	// create user-defined node dependencies done with `wait-for` property of the deployment stage
594: 	err = c.createWaitForDependency()
595: 	if err != nil {
596: 		return nil, nil, nil, err
597: 	}
598: 
599: 	// make network namespace shared containers start in the right order
600: 	c.createNamespaceSharingDependency()
601: 
602: 	// Add possible additional dependencies here
603: 
604: 	// make sure that there are no unresolvable dependencies, which would deadlock.
605: 	err = c.dependencyManager.CheckAcyclicity()
606: 	if err != nil {
607: 		return nil, nil, nil, err
608: 	}
609: 
610: 	// Buffered so workers never block reporting a failure (at most one failure path per node).
611: 	// With zero nodes, nothing sends on this channel; an empty buffer is fine.
612: 	nodeFailCh := make(chan error, len(c.Nodes))
613: 
614: 	// start scheduling
615: 	NodesWg, execCollection := c.scheduleNodes(ctx, int(maxWorkers), skipPostDeploy, nodeFailCh)
616: 
617: 	return NodesWg, execCollection, nodeFailCh, nil
618: }
619: 
620: // DeployNodes runs the node creation phase for the selected nodes.
621: func (c *CLab) DeployNodes(
622: 	ctx context.Context,
623: 	nodeNames []string,
624: 	maxWorkers uint,
625: ) error {
626: 	return c.deployNodes(ctx, nodeNames, maxWorkers, nil)
627: }
628: 
629: // deployApplyNodes schedules starts and creates together: a new sidecar can
630: // depend on a stopped target, and a stopped node can depend on a new target.
631: func (c *CLab) deployApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan, maxWorkers uint) error {
632: 	nodeNames := sortedStringSet(
633: 		unionStringSets(plan.addedNodeSet, plan.recreatedNodeSet, plan.startNodeSet),
634: 	)
635: 	return c.deployNodes(ctx, nodeNames, maxWorkers, plan.startNodeSet)
636: }
637: 
638: func (c *CLab) deployNodes(
639: 	ctx context.Context,
640: 	nodeNames []string,
641: 	maxWorkers uint,
642: 	startNodeSet map[string]struct{},
643: ) error {
644: 	if len(nodeNames) == 0 {
645: 		return nil
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	if maxWorkers == 0 || int(maxWorkers) > len(nodeNames) {
649: 		maxWorkers = uint(len(nodeNames))
650: 	}
651: 	if _, err := c.networkModeNodeOrder(nodeNames); err != nil {
652: 		return err
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	input := make(chan string)
656: 	errCh := make(chan error, len(nodeNames))
657: 	completed := make(map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion, len(nodeNames))
658: 	for _, name := range nodeNames {
659: 		completed[name] = &nodeDeployCompletion{done: make(chan struct{})}
660: 	}
661: 	finish := func(name string, err error) {
662: 		completed[name].err = err
663: 		close(completed[name].done)
664: 		errCh <- err
665: 	}
666: 
667: 	for range maxWorkers {
668: 		go func() {
669: 			for nodeName := range input {
670: 				if _, start := startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {
671: 					log.Info("Starting stopped node", "node", nodeName)
672: 					err := c.Nodes[nodeName].Start(ctx)
673: 					if err != nil {
674: 						err = fmt.Errorf("failed starting node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
675: 					}
676: 					finish(nodeName, err)
677: 					continue
678: 				}
679: 				log.Info("Creating node", "node", nodeName)
680: 				finish(nodeName, c.deployNode(ctx, c.Nodes[nodeName]))
681: 			}
682: 		}()
683: 	}
684: 
685: 	// Wait outside the worker pool. Targets in this operation signal completion
686: 	// directly, avoiding runtime polling and propagating failures to dependents.
687: 	var feedWg sync.WaitGroup
688: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
689: 		feedWg.Add(1)
690: 		go func(nodeName string) {
691: 			defer feedWg.Done()
692: 			if err := c.waitForNodeDeployTarget(ctx, nodeName, completed); err != nil {
693: 				finish(nodeName, err)
694: 				return
695: 			}
696: 			select {
697: 			case input <- nodeName:
698: 			case <-ctx.Done():
699: 				finish(nodeName, ctx.Err())
700: 			}
701: 		}(nodeName)
702: 	}
703: 	go func() {
704: 		feedWg.Wait()
705: 		close(input)
706: 	}()
707: 
708: 	var errs []error
709: 	for range nodeNames {
710: 		if err := <-errCh; err != nil {
711: 			errs = append(errs, err)
712: 		}
713: 	}
714: 
715: 	if len(errs) > 0 {
716: 		return errors.Join(errs...)
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	return nil
720: }
721: 
722: type nodeDeployCompletion struct {
723: 	done chan struct{}
724: 	// Closing done publishes err to dependent goroutines.
725: 	err error
726: }
727: 
728: func (c *CLab) waitForNodeDeployTarget(
729: 	ctx context.Context,
730: 	name string,
731: 	completed map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion,
732: ) error {
733: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
734: 		return err
735: 	}
736: 	target := networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)
737: 	if target == "" {
738: 		target = c.Nodes[name].Config().Labels[clabnodestailscale.ParentLabel]
739: 	}
740: 	if completion, selected := completed[target]; selected {
741: 		select {
742: 		case <-completion.done:
743: 			if completion.err != nil {
744: 				return fmt.Errorf(
745: 					"node %q depends on failed node %q: %w",
746: 					name,
747: 					target,
748: 					completion.err,
749: 				)
750: 			}
751: 			return nil
752: 		case <-ctx.Done():
753: 			return ctx.Err()
754: 		}
755: 	}
756: 	return c.waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx, name)
757: }
758: 
759: // waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget waits until a node's network-mode:
760: // container:<target> target is running, so apply's incremental deploy never
761: // races a newly created or recreated target against its dependent. The
762: // target may be a node in this same apply call (added or recreated
763: // alongside the dependent) or, like fresh deploy, an external container not
764: // managed by this topology.
765: func (c *CLab) waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx context.Context, nodeName string) error {
766: 	node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
767: 	if !exists {
768: 		return nil
769: 	}
770: 
771: 	target := networkModeContainerTarget(node.Config().NetworkMode)
772: 	if target == "" {
773: 		return nil
774: 	}
775: 
776: 	targetNode, internal := c.Nodes[target]
777: 	if !internal {
778: 		return c.waitForExternalNodeDependencies(ctx, nodeName)
779: 	}
780: 
781: 	runtime := c.globalRuntime()
782: 	if runtime == nil {
783: 		return fmt.Errorf("container runtime is not initialized")
784: 	}
785: 
786: 	return clabruntime.WaitForContainerRunning(ctx, runtime, targetNode.Config().LongName, nodeName)
787: }

792: 		Cert:         c.Cert,

794: 		TopoPaths:    c.TopoPaths,
795: 		SSHPubKeys:   c.SSHPubKeys,
796: 	}); err != nil {

798: 	}
799: 
800: 	if err := node.Deploy(ctx, &clabnodes.DeployParams{Nodes: c.Nodes}); err != nil {
801: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q deploy: %w", nodeName, err)
802: 	}
803: 
804: 	if err := node.UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx); err != nil {
805: 		log.Errorf("failed to update node runtime information for node %s: %v", nodeName, err)
806: 	}

816: func (c *CLab) deployLinks(
817: 	ctx context.Context,
818: 	links []clablinks.Link,
819: 	additionalNodeNames []string,
820: ) error {
821: 	touchedNodes := make(map[string]struct{}, len(additionalNodeNames))
822: 	for _, nodeName := range additionalNodeNames {
823: 		touchedNodes[nodeName] = struct{}{}
824: 	}
825: 	for _, link := range links {
826: 		log.Info("Creating link", "link", applyLinkName(link))
827: 
828: 		for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
829: 			if err := ep.Deploy(ctx); err != nil {
830: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed deploying link %s: %w", applyLinkName(link), err)
831: 			}
832: 			touchedNodes[ep.GetNode().GetShortName()] = struct{}{}
833: 		}
834: 
835: 		if err := link.PostDeploy(ctx); err != nil {
836: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed post-deploying link %s: %w", applyLinkName(link), err)
837: 		}
838: 	}
839: 
840: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedStringSet(touchedNodes) {
841: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
842: 		if !exists {
843: 			continue
844: 		}
845: 		if err := node.PostDeployEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {
846: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q post-deploy links: %w", nodeName, err)
847: 		}
848: 	}
849: 
850: 	return nil
851: }

855: 	nodeNames []string,
856: 	skipPostDeploy bool,
857: ) error {

859: 
860: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
861: 		node := c.Nodes[nodeName]
862: 
863: 		if !skipPostDeploy {
864: 			if err := node.PostDeploy(
865: 				ctx,
866: 				&clabnodes.PostDeployParams{Nodes: c.Nodes},
867: 			); err != nil {
868: 				return fmt.Errorf("node %q post-deploy: %w", nodeName, err)
869: 			}
870: 		}
871: 
872: 		if err := node.RunExecFromConfig(ctx, execCollection); err != nil {
873: 			log.Errorf("failed to run exec commands for %s: %v", nodeName, err)
874: 		}
875: 	}
876: 
877: 	execCollection.Log()
878: 
879: 	return nil
880: }

935: // configureSnapshotRestore configures nodes for snapshot restoration.
936: // It resolves snapshot files for each node and adds the necessary volume mounts
937: // and environment variables to restore from snapshots.
938: func (c *CLab) configureSnapshotRestore(options *DeployOptions) error {
939: 	// Build restore map from per-node specifications
940: 	restoreMap := make(map[string]string)
941: 	for _, mapping := range options.restoreNodeSnapshots {
942: 		parts := strings.SplitN(mapping, "=", 2)
943: 		if len(parts) != 2 {
944: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid restore format: %s (expected: node=path)", mapping)
945: 		}
946: 		restoreMap[parts[0]] = parts[1]
947: 	}
948: 
949: 	// Track statistics for logging
950: 	var restoredCount, freshCount int
951: 
952: 	// Configure each node
953: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
954: 		nodeName := node.Config().ShortName
955: 
956: 		// Resolve snapshot path for this node
957: 		snapshotPath, shouldRestore := resolveNodeSnapshot(nodeName, restoreMap, options.restoreAll)
958: 
959: 		if shouldRestore {
960: 			// Validate snapshot file exists
961: 			if _, err := os.Stat(snapshotPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
962: 				return fmt.Errorf("snapshot file not found for node %s: %s", nodeName, snapshotPath)
963: 			}
964: 
965: 			// Get absolute path for bind mount
966: 			absPath, err := filepath.Abs(snapshotPath)
967: 			if err != nil {
968: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get absolute path for %s: %w", snapshotPath, err)
969: 			}
970: 
971: 			// Add volume mount for snapshot (read-only)
972: 			node.Config().Binds = append(node.Config().Binds,
973: 				fmt.Sprintf("%s:/snapshot.tar:ro", absPath))
974: 
975: 			// Add restore environment variable
976: 			if node.Config().Env == nil {
977: 				node.Config().Env = make(map[string]string)
978: 			}
979: 			node.Config().Env["RESTORE_SNAPSHOT"] = "1"
980: 
981: 			log.Infof("Node %s will restore from: %s", nodeName, snapshotPath)
982: 			restoredCount++
983: 		} else {
984: 			freshCount++
985: 		}
986: 	}
987: 
988: 	// Log deployment mode summary if any restores are configured
989: 	if restoredCount > 0 {
990: 		log.Infof("Deploying %d nodes from snapshots, %d nodes fresh", restoredCount, freshCount)
991: 	}
992: 
993: 	return nil
994: }
995: 
996: // resolveNodeSnapshot determines the snapshot file path for a given node.
997: // Priority: per-node override > restore-all directory > none.
998: func resolveNodeSnapshot(
999: 	nodeName string,
1000: 	restoreMap map[string]string,
1001: 	restoreAll string,
1002: ) (string, bool) {
1003: 	// 1. Check per-node overrides first (highest priority)
1004: 	if snapshotPath, ok := restoreMap[nodeName]; ok {
1005: 		return snapshotPath, true
1006: 	}
1007: 
1008: 	// 2. Check restore-all directory
1009: 	if restoreAll != "" {
1010: 		// Look for {nodename}.tar in directory
1011: 		snapshotPath := filepath.Join(restoreAll, nodeName+".tar")
1012: 		if _, err := os.Stat(snapshotPath); err == nil {
1013: 			return snapshotPath, true
1014: 		}
1015: 
1016: 		// Not found - this is OK, just deploy normally
1017: 		log.Debugf("No snapshot found for node %s in %s, deploying normally", nodeName, restoreAll)
1018: 		return "", false
1019: 	}
1020: 
1021: 	// 3. No restore specified
1022: 	return "", false
1023: }

\ts := c.Config.Settings\n522: \n523: \t// Set defaults for the CA parameters\n524: \tkeySize := 2048\n525: \tvalidityDuration := time.Until(time.Now().AddDate(1, 0, 0)) // 1 year as default\n526: \tvar extCACert, extCAKey string\n527: \n528: \t// check that Settings.CertificateAuthority exists.\n529: \tif s != nil && s.CertificateAuthority != nil {\n530: \t\t// if ValidityDuration is set use value\n536: \t\tif s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize != 0 {\n537: \t\t\tkeySize = s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize\n538: \t\t}\n539: \n540: \t\t// if external CA cert and key are set, propagate to topopaths\n541: \t\textCACert = s.CertificateAuthority.Cert\n542: \t\textCAKey = s.CertificateAuthority.Key\n543: \t}\n544: \n545: \t// override external ca and key from env vars\n546: \tif v := os.Getenv(\"CLAB_CA_KEY_FILE\"); v != \"\" {\n547: \t\textCAKey = v\n548: \t}\n549: \n550: \tif v := os.Getenv(\"CLAB_CA_CERT_FILE\"); v != \"\" {\n551: \t\textCACert = v\n552: \t}\n553: \n554: \tif extCACert != \"\" && extCAKey != \"\" {\n555: \t\terr := c.TopoPaths.SetExternalCaFiles(extCACert, extCAKey)\n556: \t\tif err != nil {\n557: \t\t\treturn err\n558: \t\t}\n559: \t}\n560: \n561: \t// define the attributes used to generate the CA Cert\n562: \tcaCertInput := &clabcert.CACSRInput{\n563: \t\tCommonName:   c.Config.Name + \" lab CA\",\n564: \t\tCountry:      \"US\",\n565: \t\tExpiry: schedules nodes creation and returns a waitgroup for all nodes\n574: // with the exec collection created from the exec config of each node.\n575: // The exec collection is returned to the caller to != nil {\n590: \t\treturn nil, nil, nil, err\n591: \t}\n592: \n593: \t// create user-defined node dependencies done with `wait-for` property of the deployment stage\n594: \terr = c.createWaitForDependency()\n595: \tif err != nil {\n596: \t\treturn nil, nil, nil, err\n597: \t}\n598: \n599: \t// make network namespace shared containers start in the right order\n600: \terr = c.dependencyManager.CheckAcyclicity()\n606: \tif err != nil {\n607: \t\treturn nil, nil, nil, err\n608: \t}\n609: \n610: \t// Buffered so workers never block reporting a failure (at most one failure path per node).\n611: \t// With zero nodes, nothing sends on this channel; an empty buffer is fine.\n612: \tnodeFailCh := make(chan error, len(c.Nodes))\n613: \n614: \t// start DeployNodes runs the node creation phase for the selected nodes.\n621: func (c *CLab) DeployNodes(\n622: \tctx context.Context,\n623: \tnodeNames []string,\n624: \tmaxWorkers uint,\n625: ) error *CLab) deployNodes(\n639: \tctx context.Context,\n640: \tnodeNames []string,\n641: \tmaxWorkers uint,\n642: \tstartNodeSet map[string]struct{},\n643: ) error {\n644: \tif len(nodeNames) == 0 {\n645: \t\treturn nil\n646: \t}\n647: \n648: \tif maxWorkers == 0 || int(maxWorkers) > len(nodeNames) {\n649: \t\tmaxWorkers = uint(len(nodeNames))\n650: \t}\n651: \tif _, err := c.networkModeNodeOrder(nodeNames); err != nil {\n652: \t\treturn err\n653: \t}\n654: \n655: \tinput := make(chan string)\n656: \terrCh := make(chan error, len(nodeNames))\n657: \tcompleted := make(map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion, len(nodeNames))\n658: \tfor _, name := range nodeNames {\n659: \t\tcompleted[name] = &nodeDeployCompletion{done: make(chan struct{})}\n660: \t}\n661: \tfinish := func(name string, err error) {\n662: \t\tcompleted[name].err = err\n663: \t\tclose(completed[name].done)\n664: \t\terrCh <- err\n665: \t}\n666: \n667: \tfor range maxWorkers {\n668: \t\tgo func() {\n669: \t\t\tfor nodeName := range input {\n670: \t\t\t\tif _, start := startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {\n671: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\"Starting stopped node\", \"node\", nodeName)\n672: \t\t\t\t\terr := \t\t}()\n683: \t}\n684: \n685: \t// Wait outside the worker pool. Targets in this operation signal completion\n686: \t// directly, avoiding runtime polling and propagating failures to dependents.\n687: \tvar feedWg sync.WaitGroup\n688: \tfor _, nodeName := range nodeNames {\n689: \t\tfeedWg.Add(1)\n690: \t\tgo func(nodeName string) {\n691: \t\t\tdefer feedWg.Done()\n692: \t\t\tif err := c.waitForNodeDeployTarget(ctx, nodeName, completed); err != nil {\n693: \t\t\t\tfinish(nodeName, err)\n694: \t\t\t\treturn\n695: \t\t\t}\n696: \t\t\tselect {\n697: \t\t\tcase input <- nodeName:\n698: \t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n699: \t\t\t\tfinish(nodeName, ctx.Err())\n700: \t\t\t}\n701: \t\t}(nodeName)\n702: \t}\n703: \tgo func() {\n704: \t\tfeedWg.Wait()\n705: \t\tclose(input)\n706: \t}()\n707: \n708: \tvar errs []error\n709: \tfor range nodeNames {\n710: \t\tif err := <-errCh; err != nil {\n711: \t\t\terrs = append(errs, err)\n712: \t\t}\n713: \t}\n714: \n715: \tif len(errs) > 0 {\n716: \t\treturn errors.Join(errs...)\n717: \t}\n718: \n719: \treturn nil\n720: }\n721: \n722: type nodeDeployCompletion struct {\n723: \tdone chan struct{}\n724: \t// Closing done publishes err to dependent goroutines.\n725: \terr error\n726: }\n727: \n728: func (c *CLab) waitForNodeDeployTarget(\n729: \tctx context.Context,\n730: \tname string,\n731: \tcompleted map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion,\n732: ) error {\n733: \tif err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {\n734: \t\treturn err\n735: \t}\n736: \ttarget := networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)\n737: \tif target == \"\" {\n738: \t\ttarget = c.Nodes[name].Config().Labels[clabnodestailscale.ParentLabel]\n739: \t}\n740: \tif completion, selected := completed[target]; selected {\n741: \t\tselect {\n742: \t\tcase <-completion.done:\n743: \t\t\tif completion.err != nil {\n744: \t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n745: \t\t\t\t\t\"node %q depends on failed node %q: %w\",\n746: \t\t\t\t\tname,\n747: \t\t\t\t\ttarget,\n748: \t\t\t\t\tcompletion.err,\n749: \t\t\t\t)\n750: \t\t\t}\n751: \t\t\treturn nil\n752: \t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n753: \t\t\treturn ctx.Err()\n754: \t\t}\n755: \t}\n756: \treturn c.waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx, name)\n757: }\n758: \n759: // waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget waits until a node's network-mode:\n760: // container:<target> target is running, so apply's incremental deploy never\n761: // races a newly created or recreated target against its dependent. The\n762: // target may be a node in this same apply call (added or recreated\n763: // alongside the dependent) or, like fresh deploy, an external container not\n764: // managed by this topology.\n765: func (c *CLab) waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx context.Context, nodeName string) error {\n766: \tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n767: \tif !exists {\n768: \t\treturn nil\n769: \t}\n770: \n771: \ttarget := networkModeContainerTarget(node.Config().NetworkMode)\n772: \tif target == \"\" {\n773: \t\treturn nil\n774: \t}\n775: \n776: \ttargetNode, internal := c.Nodes[target]\n777: \tif !internal {\n778: \t\treturn c.waitForExternalNodeDependencies(ctx, nodeName)\n779: \t}\n780: \n781: \truntime := c.globalRuntime()\n782: \tif runtime == nil {\n783: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"container runtime is not initialized\")\n784: \t}\n785: \n786: \treturn clabruntime.WaitForContainerRunning(ctx, runtime, targetNode.Config().LongName, nodeName)\n787: }\n788: \n789: func (c *CLab) deployNode(ctx context.Context, node clabnodes.Node) error {\n790: \tnodeName := node.GetShortName()\n791: \tif err := node.PreDeploy(ctx, &clabnodes.PreDeployParams{\n792: \t\tCert:         c.Cert,\n793: \t\tTopologyName: c.Config.Name,\n794: \t\tTopoPaths:    c.TopoPaths,\n795: \t\tSSHPubKeys:   c.SSHPubKeys,\n796: \t}); err != nil {\n805: \t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to update node runtime information for node %s: %v\", nodeName, err)\n806: \t}\n807: \n808: \treturn nil\n809: }\n810: \n811: // DeployLinks deploys selected links through their endpoints and runs their post-deploy hooks.\n812: func (c *CLab) DeployLinks(ctx context.Context, links []clablinks.Link) error {\n813: \treturn c.deployLinks(ctx, links, nil)\n814: }\n815: \n816: func (c *CLab) deployLinks(\n817: \tctx context.Context,\n818: \tlinks []clablinks.Link,\n819: \tadditionalNodeNames []string,\n820: ) error {\n821: \ttouchedNodes := make(map[string]struct{}, len(additionalNodeNames))\n822: \tfor _, nodeName := range additionalNodeNames {\n823: \t\ttouchedNodes[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n824: \t}\n825: \tfor _, link := range links {\n826: \t\tlog.Info(\"Creating link\", \"link\", applyLinkName(link))\n827: \n828: \t\tfor _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {\n829: \t\t\tif err := ep.Deploy(ctx); err != nil {\n836: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed post-deploying link %s: %w\", applyLinkName(link), err)\n837: \t\t}\n838: \t}\n839: \n840: \tfor _, nodeName := range sortedStringSet(touchedNodes) {\n841: \t\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n842: \t\tif !exists {\n843: \t\t\tcontinue\n844: \t\t}\n845: \t\tif err := node.PostDeployEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {\n846: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q post-deploy links: %w\", nodeName, err)\n847: \t\t}\n848: \t}\n849: \n850: \treturn nil\n851: }\n852: \n853: func (c *CLab) postDeployApplyNodes(\n854: \tctx context.Context,\n855: \tnodeNames []string,\n856: \tskipPostDeploy bool,\n857: ) error {\n858: \texecCollection := clabexec.NewExecCollection()\n859: \n860: \tfor _, nodeName := range nodeNames {\n861: \t\tnode := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n862: \n863: \t\tif !skipPostDeploy {\n864: \t\t\tif err := node.PostDeploy(\n865: \t\t\t\tctx,\n866: \t\t\t\t&clabnodes.PostDeployParams{Nodes: c.Nodes},\n867: \t\t\t); err != nil {\n868: \t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q post-deploy: %w\", nodeName, err)\n869: \t\t\t}\n870: \t\t}\n871: \n872: \t\tif err := node.RunExecFromConfig(ctx, execCollection); err != nil {\n873: \t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to run exec commands for %s: %v\", nodeName, err)\n874: \t\t}\n875: \t}\n876: \n877: \texecCollection.Log()\n878: \n879: \treturn nil\n880: }\n881: \n882: func (c *CLab) finalize(\n883: \tctx context.Context,\n884: \texportTemplate string,\n885: \tgraph bool,\n886: ) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {\n887: \tif err := c.GenerateInventories(); 87: func destroyFn(cobraCmd *cobra.Command, o *Options) error {
88: 	if o.Destroy.Cleanup && len(o.Filter.NodeFilter) != 0 {
89: 		return fmt.Errorf("cleanup cannot be used with node-filter")
90: 	}
91:

94: 	}

97:

99: 		clabOptions,
100: 		// during destroy we don't want to check bind paths
101: 		// as it is irrelevant for this command.
102: 		clabcore.WithSkippedBindsPathsCheck(),
103: 	)

106: 	if err != nil {
107: 		return err
108: 	}

28: func (c *CLab) Destroy(ctx context.Context, options ...DestroyOption) (err error) {
29: 	opts := NewDestroyOptions()
30: 
31: 	for _, opt := range options {
32: 		opt(opts)
33: 	}
34: 
35: 	if c.LabRuntime != nil {
36: 		return c.destroyWithLabRuntime(ctx, opts)
37: 	}
38: 
39: 	var containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
40: 
41: 	switch {
42: 	case opts.all:
43: 		containers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx)
44: 	case c.TopoPaths.TopologyFilenameAbsPath() != "":
45: 		containers, err = c.ListNodesContainersIgnoreNotFound(ctx)
46: 		if err == nil {
47: 			var tailscaleContainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
48: 			tailscaleContainers, err = c.discoverTailscaleContainers(ctx, opts.nodeFilter)
49: 			containers = append(containers, tailscaleContainers...)
50: 		}
51: 	default:
52: 		var listOpts []ListOption
53: 
54: 		if c.Config.Name != "" {
55: 			listOpts = []ListOption{WithListLabName(c.Config.Name)}
56: 		} else {
57: 			listOpts = []ListOption{WithListclabLabelExists()}
58: 		}
59: 
60: 		containers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx, listOpts...)
61: 	}
62: 
63: 	if err != nil {
64: 		return err
65: 	}
66: 
67: 	// topo will hold the reference to the topology file
68: 	// as the key and the respective lab directory as the referenced value
69: 	topos := map[string]string{}
70: 
71: 	for idx := range containers {
72: 		topoFile, ok := containers[idx].Labels[clabconstants.TopoFile]
73: 		if !ok {
74: 			continue
75: 		}
76: 
77: 		topos[topoFile] = filepath.Dir(containers[idx].Labels[clabconstants.NodeLabDir])
78: 	}
79: 
80: 	// failedLabDirs records the lab directories whose destroy failed or was never
81: 	// attempted. --cleanup keeps those directories: deleting the lab directory of
82: 	// a lab that is still running would discard the state file destroy needs for
83: 	// its management network cleanup on the next attempt.
84: 	failedLabDirs := map[string]bool{}
85: 
86: 	defer func() {
87: 		if opts.cleanup {
88: 			if cleanupErr := c.destroyLabDirs(topos, opts.all, failedLabDirs); cleanupErr != nil {
89: 				err = errors.Join(err, cleanupErr)
90: 			}
91: 		}
92: 	}()
93: 
94: 	if len(topos) == 0 {
95: 		return nil
96: 	}
97: 
98: 	log.Debugf("got the following topologies for destroy: %+v", topos)
99: 
100: 	// if all, and cli doesn't have --yes flag, and in a terminal -- prompt user confirmation
101: 	if opts.all && opts.terminalPrompt && term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) {
102: 		err := cliPromptToDestroyAll(topos)
103: 		if err != nil {
104: 			return err
105: 		}
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	var errs []error
109: 
110: 	for topo, labDir := range topos {
111: 		cc, err := c.makeCopyForDestroy(ctx, topo, labDir, *opts)
112: 		if err != nil {
113: 			log.Errorf("error creating clab instance for topo %q: %v", topo, err)
114: 
115: 			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf(
116: 				"error creating clab instance for topo %q: %w", topo, err))
117: 			failedLabDirs[labDir] = true
118: 
119: 			continue
120: 		}
121: 
122: 		err = cc.destroy(ctx, opts.maxWorkers, opts.keepMgmtNet)
123: 		if err != nil {
124: 			log.Errorf("Error occurred during the %s lab deletion: %v", cc.Config.Name, err)
125: 			errs = append(errs, err)
126: 			failedLabDirs[labDir] = true
127: 		}
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if len(errs) != 0 {
131: 		return fmt.Errorf("error(s) occurred during the deletion. Check log messages")
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	return nil
135: }

137: // creates a mostly cloned version of the current c but set to the new topology, and with the
138: // necessary steps (mgmt network things) handled preparing the new CLab for destruction.
139: func (c *CLab) makeCopyForDestroy(
140: 	ctx context.Context,
141: 	topo,
142: 	labDir string,
143: 	opts DestroyOptions,
144: ) (*CLab, error) {
145: 	newOpts := []ClabOption{
146: 		WithTimeout(c.timeout),
147: 		// a topology edited after deploy may no longer pass the mgmt-net link checks,
148: 		// which must not prevent the removal of the deployed lab.
149: 		WithSkippedMgmtNetLinksCheck(),
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	// Try to load topology file if it exists, otherwise use lab name only.
153: 	// This allows destroying labs even when the topology file has been deleted.
154: 	// WithTopoPath / WithLabNameOnly must run before WithNodeFilter so filterClabNodes
155: 	// sees topology nodes (see filterClabNodes in clab.go).
156: 	varsFiles := opts.varsFiles
157: 	if len(varsFiles) == 0 {
158: 		varsFiles = c.TopoPaths.VarsFilenamesAbsPath()
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	if clabutils.FileOrDirExists(topo) {
162: 		newOpts = append(newOpts, WithTopoPath(topo, varsFiles))
163: 	} else {
164: 		// Derive lab name from lab directory (format: clab-<labname>)
165: 		labName := filepath.Base(labDir)
166: 		labName = strings.TrimPrefix(labName, "clab-")
167: 		log.Debugf("topology file %q not found, using lab name %q for destroy", topo, labName)
168: 		newOpts = append(newOpts, WithLabNameOnly(labName))
169: 	}
170: 
171: 	newOpts = append(newOpts,
172: 		WithNodeFilter(opts.nodeFilter),
173: 		// during destroy we don't want to check bind paths
174: 		// as it is irrelevant for this command.
175: 		WithSkippedBindsPathsCheck(),
176: 		WithRuntime(
177: 			c.globalRuntimeName,
178: 			&clabruntime.RuntimeConfig{
179: 				Debug:            c.Config.Debug,
180: 				Timeout:          c.timeout,
181: 				GracefulShutdown: opts.graceful,
182: 			},
183: 		),
184: 	)
185: 
186: 	if opts.keepMgmtNet {
187: 		newOpts = append(newOpts, WithKeepMgmtNet())
188: 	}
189: 
190: 	cc, err := NewContainerLab(newOpts...)
191: 	if err != nil {
192: 		return nil, err
193: 	}
194: 	if labDir != "" && clabutils.FileOrDirExists(labDir) {
195: 		// adjust the labdir. Usually we take the PWD. but now on destroy time,
196: 		// we might be in a different Dir.
197: 		err = cc.TopoPaths.SetLabDir(labDir)
198: 		if err != nil {
199: 			return nil, err
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: 
203: 	// populate the management network state (bridge names) destroy needs for the
204: 	// removal of the iptables rules, without creating networks that are missing:
205: 	// a lab deployed with a management network override leaves the topology's
206: 	// default network uncreated, and creating it here would collide with the
207: 	// subnets the override is using.
208: 	if !cc.mgmtNetworksSkipped() {
209: 		var bridged clabtypes.MgmtNetworks
210: 		for _, m := range cc.allMgmtNetworks() {
211: 			if m.Driver != clabtypes.MgmtDriverMacvlan {
212: 				bridged = append(bridged, m)
213: 			}
214: 		}
215: 		if err = cc.resolveExistingMgmtNetworks(ctx, bridged); err != nil {
216: 			return nil, err
217: 		}
218: 	}
219: 
220: 	err = cc.setMgmtNetLinkBridges()
221: 	if err != nil {
222: 		return nil, err
223: 	}
224: 
225: 	err = cc.ResolveLinks()
226: 	if err != nil {
227: 		return nil, err
228: 	}
229: 
230: 	return cc, nil
231: }
232: 
233: // resolveExistingMgmtNetworks inspects the management networks that already exist
234: // so their bridge names are populated, e.g. for the iptables cleanup on destroy.
235: // Networks that do not exist are skipped: they hold no bridge yet, and the callers
236: // must not create management networks. Runtimes that cannot check network existence
237: // keep the create-or-inspect behavior.
238: func (c *CLab) resolveExistingMgmtNetworks(
239: 	ctx context.Context,
240: 	networks clabtypes.MgmtNetworks,
241: ) error {
242: 	var existing clabtypes.MgmtNetworks
243: 
244: 	for _, m := range networks {
245: 		rt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)
246: 		if rtErr != nil {
247: 			// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks
248: 			log.Debug(
249: 				"Skipping management network resolution", "network", m.Network, "error", rtErr,
250: 			)
251: 			continue
252: 		}
253: 
254: 		checker, ok := rt.(clabruntime.MgmtNetworkChecker)
255: 		if !ok {
256: 			existing = append(existing, m)
257: 			continue
258: 		}
259: 
260: 		exists, err := checker.MgmtNetworkExists(ctx)
261: 		if err != nil {
262: 			return err
263: 		}
264: 		if !exists {
265: 			log.Debug("Skipping management network that does not exist", "network", m.Network)
266: 			continue
267: 		}
268: 
269: 		existing = append(existing, m)
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	return c.createNetworks(ctx, existing)
273: }
274: 
275: // destroyLabDirs removes the lab directories of the destroyed labs. Directories
276: // recorded in failedLabDirs are kept: their labs are still running, and the
277: // directory holds the lab state a later destroy attempt relies on.
278: func (c *CLab) destroyLabDirs(
279: 	topos map[string]string,
280: 	all bool,
281: 	failedLabDirs map[string]bool,
282: ) error {
283: 	if len(topos) == 0 {
284: 		log.Info("no containerlab containers found")
285: 
286: 		if !all {
287: 			labDir := c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir()
288: 			if labDir == "" {
289: 				// Try to infer the precise lab directory when TopologyLabDir is not set,
290: 				// e.g. destroy --name without topology file. Only look for an exact
291: 				// clab-<name> match, never a wildcard.
292: 				if c.Config != nil && c.Config.Name != "" {
293: 					candidates := []string{}
294: 					if base := os.Getenv("CLAB_LABDIR_BASE"); base != "" {
295: 						candidates = append(candidates, filepath.Join(base, "clab-"+c.Config.Name))
296: 					}
297: 					if c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileIsSet() {
298: 						candidates = append(
299: 							candidates,
300: 							filepath.Join(c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileDir(), "clab-"+c.Config.Name),
301: 						)
302: 					} else {
303: 						if wd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil && wd != "" {
304: 							candidates = append(
305: 								candidates,
306: 								filepath.Join(wd, "clab-"+c.Config.Name),
307: 							)
308: 						}
309: 					}
310: 					for _, cand := range candidates {
311: 						if _, err := os.Stat(cand); err == nil {
312: 							labDir = cand
313: 							break
314: 						}
315: 					}
316: 					if labDir == "" {
317: 						log.Info(
318: 							"lab directory not found, nothing to clean",
319: 							"candidates",
320: 							candidates,
321: 						)
322: 						return nil
323: 					}
324: 				} else {
325: 					log.Info("lab directory not found, nothing to clean")
326: 					return nil
327: 				}
328: 			}
329: 
330: 			// Safety: only remove directories that look like a lab directory.
331: 			base := filepath.Base(labDir)
332: 			if !strings.HasPrefix(base, "clab-") {
333: 				log.Warnf("refusing to remove lab directory %q: unexpected name", labDir)
334: 				return nil
335: 			}
336: 			if c.Config != nil && c.Config.Name != "" {
337: 				expected := "clab-" + c.Config.Name
338: 				if base != expected {
339: 					log.Warnf(
340: 						"refusing to remove lab directory %q: does not match expected %q",
341: 						labDir,
342: 						expected,
343: 					)
344: 					return nil
345: 				}
346: 			}
347: 
348: 			if _, err := os.Stat(labDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
349: 				log.Info("lab directory not found, nothing to clean", "path", labDir)
350: 				return nil
351: 			} else if err != nil {
352: 				log.Debug("failed to stat lab directory, skipping", "path", labDir, "error", err)
353: 				return nil
354: 			}
355: 
356: 			log.Info("Removing lab directory", "path", labDir)
357: 			if err := os.RemoveAll(labDir); err != nil {
358: 				log.Errorf("error deleting lab directory: %v", err)
359: 				return err
360: 			}
361: 		}
362: 
363: 		return nil
364: 	}
365: 
366: 	for _, labdir := range topos {
367: 		if failedLabDirs[labdir] {
368: 			log.Warnf(
369: 				"keeping lab directory %s: the lab was not destroyed, so its state is kept for a later attempt",
370: 				labdir,
371: 			)
372: 
373: 			continue
374: 		}
375: 
376: 		err := os.RemoveAll(labdir)
377: 		if err != nil {
378: 			log.Errorf("error deleting lab directory: %v", err)
379: 		}
380: 	}
381: 
382: 	return nil
383: }

385: func (c *CLab) destroy(ctx context.Context, maxWorkers uint, keepMgmtNet bool) error {
386: 	var containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
387: 	var orphanSidecars []clabruntime.GenericContainer
388: 	var err error
389: 
390: 	// If we have nodes defined (from topology file), list containers by node.
391: 	// Otherwise, list containers by lab name label (for destroy-by-name-only case).
392: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {
393: 		containers, err = c.ListNodesContainersIgnoreNotFound(ctx)
394: 	} else if c.Config.Name != "" {
395: 		containers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	if err != nil {
399: 		return err
400: 	}
401: 
402: 	if len(c.Nodes) == 0 {
403: 		c.addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers)
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {
407: 		tailscaleContainers, err := c.discoverTailscaleContainers(ctx, c.nodeFilter)
408: 		if err != nil {
409: 			return err
410: 		}
411: 		for _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {
412: 			if _, desired := c.Nodes[ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]]; desired {
413: 				continue
414: 			}
415: 			containers = append(containers, ctr)
416: 			if ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] == "" {
417: 				orphanSidecars = append(orphanSidecars, ctr)
418: 			}
419: 		}
420: 	}
421: 
422: 	if len(containers) == 0 {
423: 		return nil
424: 	}
425: 
426: 	if maxWorkers == 0 {
427: 		maxWorkers = uint(len(containers))
428: 	}
429: 
430: 	log.Info("Destroying lab", "name", c.Config.Name)
431: 
432: 	// If we have nodes defined, use the normal node-based deletion.
433: 	// Otherwise, delete containers directly via the runtime (for destroy-by-name-only case).
434: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {
435: 		c.preDestroyNodes(ctx, slices.Collect(maps.Values(c.Nodes)), maxWorkers)
436: 
437: 		err := clablinks.CleanupFilteredLinks(
438: 			ctx,
439: 			c.Config.Topology.Links,
440: 			c.Config.Name,
441: 			c.nodeFilter,
442: 		)
443: 		if err != nil {
444: 			return err
445: 		}
446: 		c.deleteNodes(ctx, maxWorkers)
447: 		c.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, orphanSidecars)
448: 	} else {
449: 		c.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, containers)
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	c.deleteToolContainers(ctx)
453: 
454: 	log.Info("Removing host entries", "path", "/etc/hosts")
455: 
456: 	err = c.DeleteEntriesFromHostsFile()
457: 	if err != nil {
458: 		return fmt.Errorf("error while trying to clean up the hosts file: %w", err)
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	log.Info("Removing SSH config", "path", c.TopoPaths.SSHConfigPath())
462: 
463: 	err = c.RemoveSSHConfig(c.TopoPaths)
464: 	if err != nil {
465: 		log.Errorf("failed to remove ssh config file: %v", err)
466: 	}
467: 
468: 	// delete container network namespaces symlinks
469: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
470: 		err = node.DeleteNetnsSymlink()
471: 		if err != nil {
472: 			return fmt.Errorf("error while deleting netns symlinks: %w", err)
473: 		}
474: 	}
475: 
476: 	// delete every defined management network, including extra networks
477: 	// that apply may have left without nodes, and networks a previous
478: 	// deployment recorded in the lab state but the topology no longer defines
479: 	for _, m := range c.mgmtNetworksForCleanup() {
480: 		if m.Network == "bridge" || keepMgmtNet {
481: 			continue
482: 		}
483: 		log.Debugf("Calling DeleteNet method. Management network value is: %+v", m)
484: 
485: 		rt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)
486: 		if rtErr != nil {
487: 			// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks
488: 			log.Debug("Skipping management network deletion", "network", m.Network, "error", rtErr)
489: 			continue
490: 		}
491: 		if err = rt.DeleteNet(ctx); err != nil {
492: 			switch {
493: 			case err.Error() == fmt.Sprintf("Error: No such network: %s", m.Network):
494: 			case strings.Contains(err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(" network %s not found", m.Network)):
495: 			default:
496: 				log.Error(err)
497: 			}
498: 		}
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	return nil
502: }

504: func (c *CLab) addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer) {
505: 	for _, ctr := range containers {
506: 		switch name := ctr.NetworkName; name {
507: 		case "", "unknown", "bridge", "host", "none":
508: 		default:
509: 			if c.mgmtNetByNetwork(name).Network == name {
510: 				continue
511: 			}
512: 			c.Config.MgmtNetworks = append(c.Config.MgmtNetworks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{
513: 				Network:        name,
514: 				Bridge:         ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr],
515: 				ExternalAccess: new(true),
516: 			})
517: 		}
518: 	}
519: }
520: 
521: // mgmtNetworksForCleanup returns the management networks to delete on destroy:
522: // the topology-defined ones plus any network a previous deployment recorded in
523: // the lab state but that the current topology no longer defines. Without the
524: // state record a network dropped from the mgmt list would never be removed.
525: func (c *CLab) mgmtNetworksForCleanup() clabtypes.MgmtNetworks {
526: 	networks := c.allMgmtNetworks()
527: 
528: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
529: 	if err != nil {
530: 		log.Warn("Unable to load the management networks recorded in the lab state", "error", err)
531: 		return networks
532: 	}
533: 	if state == nil {
534: 		return networks
535: 	}
536: 
537: 	defined := make(map[string]bool, len(networks))
538: 	for _, m := range networks {
539: 		defined[m.Network] = true
540: 	}
541: 	for _, name := range state.MgmtNetworks {
542: 		if defined[name] {
543: 			continue
544: 		}
545: 		defined[name] = true
546: 		// ExternalAccess mirrors the default every management network gets, so
547: 		// the forwarding rule installed for the network is cleaned up too.
548: 		networks = append(networks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{
549: 			Network:        name,
550: 			ExternalAccess: new(true),
551: 		})
552: 	}
553: 
554: 	return networks
555: }

557: func (c *CLab) deleteApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
558: 	nodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(plan.deletedNodeSet)+len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))
559: 	for nodeName := range plan.deletedNodeSet {
560: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
561: 	}
562: 	for nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
563: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
564: 	}
565: 	sort.Strings(nodeNames)
566: 
567: 	hookNodes := make([]clabnodes.Node, 0, len(nodeNames))
568: 	var tailscaleContainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
569: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
570: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
571: 		if runtimeNode == nil {
572: 			return fmt.Errorf("runtime node %q not found", nodeName)
573: 		}
574: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
575: 			continue
576: 		}
577: 		if len(runtimeNode.containers) > 0 &&
578: 			runtimeNode.containers[0].Labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] == clabnodestailscale.KindName {
579: 			tailscaleContainers = append(tailscaleContainers, runtimeNode.containers...)
580: 			continue
581: 		}
582: 		if node, ok := c.Nodes[nodeName]; ok {
583: 			hookNodes = append(hookNodes, node)
584: 		}
585: 	}
586: 	var logoutWg sync.WaitGroup
587: 	for _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {
588: 		logoutWg.Go(func() { c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, ctr) })
589: 	}
590: 	c.preDestroyNodes(ctx, hookNodes, 0)
591: 	logoutWg.Wait()
592: 
593: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
594: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
595: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
596: 			continue
597: 		}
598: 
599: 		for i := len(runtimeNode.containers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
600: 			ctr := runtimeNode.containers[i]
601: 			if len(ctr.Names) == 0 {
602: 				return fmt.Errorf("runtime container for node %q has no name", nodeName)
603: 			}
604: 
605: 			runtime := ctr.Runtime
606: 			if runtime == nil {
607: 				runtime = c.globalRuntime()
608: 			}
609: 
610: 			action := "Deleting node"
611: 			if _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {
612: 				action = "Deleting node for recreate"
613: 			}
614: 			log.Info(action, "node", nodeName, "container", ctr.Names[0])
615: 			if err := runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, ctr.Names[0]); err != nil {
616: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed deleting node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
617: 			}
618: 
619: 			_ = clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(ctr.Names[0])
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	return nil
624: }

626: // preDestroyNodes runs the PreDestroy stage of the given nodes concurrently, before any of them
627: // is deleted. Nodes without a container are skipped. A workers value of 0 runs all hooks at once.
628: func (*CLab) preDestroyNodes(ctx context.Context, nodes []clabnodes.Node, workers uint) {
629: 	if workers == 0 || workers > uint(len(nodes)) {
630: 		workers = uint(len(nodes))
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	sem := make(chan struct{}, workers)
634: 	wg := new(sync.WaitGroup)
635: 
636: 	for _, n := range nodes {
637: 		wg.Add(1)
638: 		sem <- struct{}{}
639: 
640: 		go func() {
641: 			defer wg.Done()
642: 			defer func() { <-sem }()
643: 
644: 			if n.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
645: 				return
646: 			}
647: 
648: 			if err := n.PreDestroy(ctx); err != nil {
649: 				log.Warnf("node %q pre-destroy hook failed: %v", n.Config().ShortName, err)
650: 			}
651: 		}()
652: 	}
653: 
654: 	wg.Wait()
655: }
656: 
657: func (c *CLab) deleteNodes(ctx context.Context, workers uint) {
658: 	wg := new(sync.WaitGroup)
659: 
660: 	concurrentChan := make(chan clabnodes.Node)
661: 
662: 	workerFunc := func(i uint, input chan clabnodes.Node, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
663: 		defer wg.Done()
664: 
665: 		for {
666: 			select {
667: 			case n := <-input:
668: 				if n == nil {
669: 					log.Debugf("Worker %d terminating...", i)
670: 					return
671: 				}
672: 
673: 				err := n.Delete(ctx)
674: 				if err != nil {
675: 					log.Errorf("could not remove container %q: %v", n.Config().LongName, err)
676: 				}
677: 			case <-ctx.Done():
678: 				return
679: 			}
680: 		}
681: 	}
682: 
683: 	// start concurrent workers
684: 	wg.Add(int(workers))
685: 
686: 	for i := range workers {
687: 		go workerFunc(i, concurrentChan, wg)
688: 	}
689: 
690: 	// send nodes to workers
691: 	for _, n := range c.Nodes {
692: 		concurrentChan <- n
693: 	}
694: 
695: 	// close channel to terminate the workers
696: 	close(concurrentChan)
697: 
698: 	// also call delete on the special nodes
699: 	specialNodes := append(
700: 		[]clablinks.Node{clablinks.GetHostLinkNode()},
701: 		clablinks.GetMgmtBrLinkNodes()...,
702: 	)
703: 	for _, n := range specialNodes {
704: 		err := n.Delete(ctx)
705: 		if err != nil {
706: 			log.Warn(err)
707: 		}
708: 	}
709: 
710: 	wg.Wait()
711: }

713: // deleteContainersDirect deletes containers directly via the runtime API.
714: // This is used when we don't have node objects (e.g., destroy-by-name-only case).
715: func (c *CLab) deleteContainersDirect(
716: 	ctx context.Context,
717: 	containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,
718: ) {
719: 	for _, cont := range containers {
720: 		if len(cont.Names) == 0 {
721: 			log.Warnf("skipping container %s with no names", cont.ID)
722: 			continue
723: 		}
724: 		name := cont.Names[0]
725: 		log.Infof("Removing container: %s", name)
726: 
727: 		c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, cont)
728: 		rt := cont.Runtime
729: 		if rt == nil {
730: 			rt = c.globalRuntime()
731: 		}
732: 		err := rt.DeleteContainer(ctx, name)
733: 		if err != nil {
734: 			log.Errorf("could not remove container %q: %v", name, err)
735: 		}
736: 	}
737: }

739: func (c *CLab) deleteToolContainers(ctx context.Context) {
740: 	toolTypes := []string{"sshx", "gotty"}
741: 
742: 	if len(c.nodeFilter) == 0 {
743: 		toolTypes = append(toolTypes, clabnodestailscale.ToolType)
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	for _, toolType := range toolTypes {
747: 		toolFilter := []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
748: 			{
749: 				FilterType: "label",
750: 				Field:      clabconstants.ToolType,
751: 				Operator:   "=",
752: 				Match:      toolType,
753: 			},
754: 			{
755: 				FilterType: "label",
756: 				Field:      clabconstants.Containerlab,
757: 				Operator:   "=",
758: 				Match:      c.Config.Name,
759: 			},
760: 		}
761: 
762: 		containers, err := c.globalRuntime().ListContainers(ctx, toolFilter)
763: 		if err != nil {
764: 			log.Error("Failed to list tool containers", "tool", toolType, "error", err)
765: 			continue
766: 		}
767: 
768: 		if len(containers) == 0 {
769: 			log.Debug("No tool containers found for lab", "tool", toolType, "lab", c.Config.Name)
770: 			continue
771: 		}
772: 
773: 		log.Info("Found tool containers associated with a lab", "tool", toolType, "lab",
774: 			c.Config.Name, "count", len(containers))
775: 
776: 		for idx := range containers {
777: 			containerName := strings.TrimPrefix(containers[idx].Names[0], "/")
778: 
779: 			log.Info("Removing tool container", "tool", toolType, "container", containerName)
780: 
781: 			c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, containers[idx])
782: 			if err := c.globalRuntime().DeleteContainer(ctx, containerName); err != nil {
783: 				log.Error("Failed to remove tool container", "tool", toolType,
784: 					"container", containerName, "error", err)
785: 			} else {
786: 				log.Info(
787: 					"Tool container removed successfully",
788: 					"tool",
789: 					toolType,
790: 					"container",
791: 					containerName,
792: 				)
793: 			}
794: 		}
795: 	}
796: }

798: func cliPromptToDestroyAll(topos map[string]string) error {
799: 	var sb strings.Builder
800: 
801: 	idx := 1
802: 
803: 	for topo, labDir := range topos {
804: 		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. Topology: %s\n     Lab Dir: %s\n", idx, topo, labDir))
805: 		idx++
806: 	}
807: 
808: 	log.Warn("The following labs will be removed:", "labs", sb.String())
809: 
810: 	// red color (ansi code 1)
811: 	warningStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true).Foreground(lipgloss.Color("1"))
812: 	prompt := "Are you sure you want to remove all labs listed above? Enter 'y'," +
813: 		" to confirm or ENTER to abort: "
814: 	fmt.Print(warningStyle.Render(prompt))
815: 
816: 	reader := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
817: 
818: 	input, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
819: 	if err != nil {
820: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read user input: %v", err)
821: 	}
822: 
823: 	answer := strings.TrimSpace(input)
824: 	if answer == "" {
825: 		return errors.New("aborted by the user. No labs were removed")
826: 	}
827: 
828: 	answer = strings.ToLower(answer)
829: 	if answer != "y" && answer != "yes" {
830: 		return errors.New("aborted by the user. No labs were removed")
831: 	}
832: 
833: 	return nil
834: }

\t// sees topology nodes (see filterClabNodes in clab.go).\n156: \tvarsFiles := opts.varsFiles\n157: \tif len(varsFiles) == 0 {\n158: \t\tvarsFiles = c.TopoPaths.VarsFilenamesAbsPath()\n159: \t}\n160: destroy\", topo, labName)\n168: \t\tnewOpts = append(newOpts, WithLabNameOnly(labName))\n169: \t}\n170: \n171: \tnewOpts = append(newOpts,\n172: \t\tWithNodeFilter(opts.nodeFilter),\n173: \t\t// Runtimes that cannot check network existence\n237: // keep the create-or-inspect behavior.\n238: func (c *CLab) resolveExistingMgmtNetworks(\n239: \tctx context.Context,\n240: \tnetworks clabtypes.MgmtNetworks,\n241: ) error {\n242: \tvar existing clabtypes.MgmtNetworks\n243: \n244: \tfor _, m := range networks {\n245: \t\trt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)\n246: \t\tif rtErr != nil {\n247: \t\t\t// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks\n248: \t\t\tlog.Debug(\n249: \t\t\t\t\"Skipping management network resolution\", \"network\", m.Network, \"error\", rtErr,\n250: \t\t\t)\n251: \t\t\tcontinue\n252: \t\t}\n253: \n254: \t\tchecker, ok := rt.(clabruntime.MgmtNetworkChecker)\n255: \t\tif !ok {\n256: \t\t\texisting = append(existing, m)\n257: \t\t\tcontinue\n258: \t\t}\n259: \n260: \t\texists, err := checker.MgmtNetworkExists(ctx)\n261: \t\tif err != nil {\n262: \t\t\treturn err\n263: \t\t}\n264: \t\tif !exists {\n265: \t\t\tlog.Debug(\"Skipping management network that does not exist\", \"network\", m.Network)\n266: \t\t\tcontinue\n267: \t\t}\n268: \n269: \t\texisting = append(existing, m)\n270: \t}\n271: \n272: \treturn c.createNetworks(ctx, existing)\n273: }\n274: \n275: // destroyLabDirs removes the lab directories of the destroyed labs. Only look for an exact\n291: \t\t\t\t// clab-<name> match, never a wildcard.\n292: \t\t\t\tif c.Config != nil && c.Config.Name != \"\" {\n293: \t\t\t\t\tcandidates := []string{}\n294: \t\t\t\t\tif \"clab-\"+c.Config.Name),\n301: \t\t\t\t\t\t)\n302: \t\t\t\t\t} else {\n303: \t\t\t\t\t\tif wd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil && wd != \"\" {\n304: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates = append(\n305: candidates {\n311: \t\t\t\t\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(cand); err == nil {\n312: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tlabDir = cand\n313: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n314: \t\t\t\t\t\t}\n315: \t\t\t\t\t}\n316: \t\t\t\t\tif labDir == \"\" {\n317: \t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\n318: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"lab directory not found, nothing to clean\",\n319: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"candidates\",\n320: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates,\n321: \t\t\t\t\t\t)\n322: 356: }

358: func (n *srl) PreDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PreDeployParams) error {
359: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(n.Cfg.LabDir, clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
360: 
361: 	// store provided pubkeys
362: 	n.sshPubKeys = params.SSHPubKeys
363: 
364: 	// store the certificate-related parameters
365: 	// for cert generation to happen in Post-Deploy phase with mgmt IPs as SANs
366: 	n.cert = params.Cert
367: 	n.topologyName = params.TopologyName
368: 
369: 	// platform specific pre-deploy actions
370: 	// modular chassis boot in the mode required by the line card generation they are populated
371: 	// with, unless the user pinned the mode explicitly.
372: 	if n.Config().Env["SRL_CHASSIS_MODE"] == "" {
373: 		topology, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg)
374: 		if err != nil {
375: 			return err
376: 		}
377: 
378: 		if topology.ChassisMode != "" {
379: 			n.Config().Env["SRL_CHASSIS_MODE"] = topology.ChassisMode
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: 
383: 	return n.createSRLFiles()
384: }
385: 
386: func (n *srl) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {
387: 	log.Info("Running postdeploy actions",
388: 		"kind", n.Cfg.Kind,
389: 		"node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
390: 
391: 	// generate the certificate
392: 	certificate, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(n.cert, n.topologyName)
393: 	if err != nil {
394: 		return err
395: 	}
396: 
397: 	// set the certificate data
398: 	n.Config().TLSCert = string(certificate.Cert)
399: 	n.Config().TLSKey = string(certificate.Key)
400: 
401: 	// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface
402: 	if err := n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {
403: 		log.Warnf("Unable to populate hosts for node %q: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	// start waiting for initial commit and mgmt server ready
407: 	if err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {
408: 		return err
409: 	}
410: 
411: 	n.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)
412: 	if err != nil {
413: 		return err
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	n.supportsOpenconfig, err = n.OpenConfigFeatureEnabled(ctx)
417: 	if err != nil {
418: 		return err
419: 	}
420: 
421: 	// return if config file is found in the lab directory.
422: 	// This can be either if the startup-config has been mounted by that path
423: 	// or the config has been previously generated and saved
424: 	if clabutils.FileExists(filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")) {
425: 		return nil
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	if err := n.addDefaultConfig(ctx); err != nil {
429: 		return err
430: 	}
431: 
432: 	if err := n.addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx); err != nil {
433: 		return err
434: 	}
435: 
436: 	// once default and overlay config is added, we can commit the config
437: 	if err := n.commitConfig(ctx); err != nil {
438: 		return err
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	return n.generateCheckpoint(ctx)
442: }

444: func (n *srl) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {
445: 	cmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(saveCmd)
446: 
447: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
448: 	if err != nil {
449: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: failed to execute cmd: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
453: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s errors: %s", n.Cfg.ShortName, execResult.GetStdErrString())
454: 	}
455: 
456: 	cfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")
457: 
458: 	log.Infof(
459: 		"saved SR Linux configuration from %s node. Output:\n%s",
460: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
461: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
462: 	)
463: 
464: 	return &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{
465: 		ConfigPath: cfgPath,
466: 	}, nil
467: }

469: // Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config
470: // commands
471: // returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.
472: func (n *srl) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {
473: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)
474: 	defer cancel()
475: 
476: 	var err error
477: 
478: 	log.Debugf("Waiting for SR Linux node %q to boot...", n.Cfg.ShortName)
479: 
480: 	for {
481: 		select {
482: 		case <-ctx.Done():
483: 			return fmt.Errorf(
484: 				"timed out waiting for SR Linux node %s to boot: %v",
485: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
486: 				err,
487: 			)
488: 		default:
489: 			// two commands are checked, first if the mgmt_server is running
490: 			cmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(mgmtServerRdyCmd)
491: 
492: 			execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
493: 			if err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {
494: 				logMsg := "mgmt_server status check failed"
495: 
496: 				if err != nil {
497: 					logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(" error: %v", err)
498: 				}
499: 
500: 				if execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {
501: 					logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(", output: \n%s", execResult)
502: 				}
503: 
504: 				log.Debug(logMsg)
505: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
506: 
507: 				continue
508: 			}
509: 
510: 			if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
511: 				log.Debugf(
512: 					"error during checking SR Linux boot status: %s",
513: 					execResult.GetStdErrString(),
514: 				)
515: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
516: 
517: 				continue
518: 			}
519: 
520: 			if !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), "running") {
521: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
522: 
523: 				continue
524: 			}
525: 
526: 			// once mgmt server is running, we need to check if it is ready to accept configuration
527: 			// commands
528: 			// this is done with checking readyForConfigCmd
529: 			cmd, _ = clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(readyForConfigCmd)
530: 
531: 			execResult, err = n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
532: 			if err != nil {
533: 				log.Debugf("error during readyForConfigCmd execution: %s", err)
534: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
535: 
536: 				continue
537: 			}
538: 
539: 			if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
540: 				log.Debugf("readyForConfigCmd stderr: %s", execResult.GetStdErrString())
541: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
542: 
543: 				continue
544: 			}
545: 
546: 			if !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), "loaded initial configuration") {
547: 				log.Debugf(
548: 					"Management server readiness files doesn't contain the marker string %s",
549: 					execResult.GetStdOutString(),
550: 				)
551: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
552: 
553: 				continue
554: 			}
555: 
556: 			log.Debugf("Node %s is ready to accept configs", n.Cfg.ShortName)
557: 
558: 			return nil
559: 		}
560: 	}
561: }

563: // checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.
564: func (*srl) checkKernelVersion() error {
565: 	// retrieve running kernel version
566: 	kv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()
567: 	if err != nil {
568: 		return err
569: 	}
570: 
571: 	// do the comparison
572: 	if !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {
573: 		log.Infof(
574: 			"Nokia SR Linux v23.3.1+ requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s",
575: 			requiredKernelVersion,
576: 			kv,
577: 		)
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	return nil
581: }

583: func (n *srl) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {
584: 	// perform the srl specific kernel version check
585: 	err := n.checkKernelVersion()
586: 	if err != nil {
587: 		return err
588: 	}
589: 
590: 	return n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)
591: }

593: func (n *srl) createSRLFiles() error {
594: 	log.Debugf("Creating directory structure for SRL container: %s", n.Cfg.ShortName)
595: 
596: 	var src string
597: 
598: 	if n.Cfg.License != "" {
599: 		// copy license file to node specific directory in lab
600: 		src = n.Cfg.License
601: 
602: 		licPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "license.key")
603: 		if err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), src, licPath,
604: 			clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {
605: 			return fmt.Errorf("CopyFile src %s -> dst %s failed %v", src, licPath, err)
606: 		}
607: 
608: 		log.Debugf("CopyFile src %s -> dst %s succeeded", src, licPath)
609: 	}
610: 
611: 	// generate SRL topology file, including base MAC
612: 	err := generateSRLTopologyFile(n.Cfg)
613: 	if err != nil {
614: 		return err
615: 	}
616: 
617: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config"),
618: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
619: 
620: 	// create repository files (for yum/apt) that
621: 	// are mounted to srl container during the init phase
622: 	err = n.createRepoFiles()
623: 	if err != nil {
624: 		return err
625: 	}
626: 
627: 	// generate a startup config file
628: 	// if the node has a `startup-config:` statement, the file specified in that section
629: 	// will be used as a template in GenerateConfig()
630: 	var cfgTemplate string
631: 
632: 	cfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")
633: 	if n.Cfg.StartupConfig != "" {
634: 		log.Debug("Reading startup-config", "file", n.Cfg.StartupConfig)
635: 
636: 		c, err := os.ReadFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig)
637: 		if err != nil {
638: 			return err
639: 		}
640: 
641: 		cBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(bytes.NewReader(c), n.Cfg)
642: 		if err != nil {
643: 			return err
644: 		}
645: 
646: 		// Determine if startup-config is a JSON file
647: 		// Get slice of data with optional leading whitespace removed.
648: 		// See RFC 7159, Section 2 for the definition of JSON whitespace.
649: 		x := bytes.TrimLeft(cBuf.Bytes(), " \t\r\n")
650: 
651: 		isJSON := len(x) > 0 && x[0] == '{'
652: 		if !isJSON {
653: 			log.Debugf(
654: 				"startup-config passed to %s is in the CLI format. Will apply it in post-deploy stage",
655: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
656: 			)
657: 
658: 			n.startupCliCfg = cBuf.Bytes()
659: 
660: 			// no need to generate and mount startup-config passed in a CLI format
661: 			// as we will apply it over the top of a default config in the post deploy stage
662: 			return nil
663: 		}
664: 
665: 		cfgTemplate = cBuf.String()
666: 	}
667: 
668: 	if cfgTemplate == "" {
669: 		log.Debugf(
670: 			"configuration template for node %s is empty, skipping startup config file generation",
671: 			n.Cfg.ShortName,
672: 		)
673: 
674: 		return nil
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	err = n.GenerateConfig(cfgPath, cfgTemplate)
678: 	if err != nil {
679: 		log.Errorf("node=%s, failed to generate config: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
680: 	}
681: 
682: 	return err
683: }

685: // srlTemplateData top level data struct.
686: type srlTemplateData struct {
687: 	TLSKey     string
688: 	TLSCert    string
689: 	TLSAnchor  string
690: 	TLSConfig  string
691: 	Banner     string
692: 	IFaces     map[string]tplIFace
693: 	SSHPubKeys string
694: 	MgmtMTU    int
695: 	MgmtIPMTU  int
696: 	DNSServers []string
697: 	// EnableGNMIUnixSockServices enables GNMI unix socket services
698: 	// for the node. This is needed for "23.10 <= ver < 24.3" versions
699: 	EnableGNMIUnixSockServices bool
700: 	// EnableCustomPrompt enables custom prompt with added newline
701: 	// before the prompt.
702: 	EnableCustomPrompt bool
703: 	CustomPrompt       string
704: 	// SNMPConfig is a string containing SNMP configuration
705: 	SNMPConfig string
706: 	// GRPCConfig is a string containing GRPC configuration
707: 	GRPCConfig string
708: 	// ACLConfig is a string containing ACL configuration
709: 	ACLConfig string
710: 	// NetconfConfig is a string containing Netconf server configuration
711: 	NetconfConfig string
712: 	// EDAConfig is a string containing EDA configuration
713: 	EDAConfig string
714: 	// OCServerConfig is a string containing OpenConfig server configuration
715: 	OCServerConfig string
716: 	// NDKServerConfig is a string containing NDK server configuration
717: 	NDKServerConfig string
718: 	// DNSServersConfig is a string containing DNS servers configuration
719: 	DNSServersConfig string
720: }
721: 
722: // tplIFace template interface struct.
723: type tplIFace struct {
724: 	BaseName    string // base interface excl. breakout
725: 	FullName    string // full interface name incl. breakout
726: 	HasBreakout bool
727: 	Mtu         int
728: 	IPv4        string
729: 	IPv6        string
730: }
731: 
732: // addDefaultConfig adds srl default configuration such as tls certs, gnmi/json-rpc, login-banner.
733: func (n *srl) addDefaultConfig(ctx context.Context) error {
734: 	b, err := n.banner()
735: 	if err != nil {
736: 		return err
737: 	}
738: 
739: 	var dnsServers []string
740: 	if n.Config().DNS != nil {
741: 		dnsServers = n.Config().DNS.Servers
742: 	}
743: 
744: 	// tplData holds data used in templating of the default config snippet
745: 	tplData := srlTemplateData{
746: 		TLSKey:           n.Cfg.TLSKey,
747: 		TLSCert:          n.Cfg.TLSCert,
748: 		TLSAnchor:        n.Cfg.TLSAnchor,
749: 		Banner:           b,
750: 		IFaces:           map[string]tplIFace{},
751: 		MgmtMTU:          0,
752: 		MgmtIPMTU:        0,
753: 		DNSServers:       dnsServers,
754: 		SNMPConfig:       snmpv2Config,
755: 		GRPCConfig:       grpcConfig,
756: 		OCServerConfig:   "",
757: 		NDKServerConfig:  "",
758: 		DNSServersConfig: "",
759: 	}
760: 
761: 	if err := n.setVersionSpecificParams(&tplData); err != nil {
762: 		return err
763: 	}
764: 
765: 	n.setCustomPrompt(&tplData)
766: 
767: 	// set MgmtMTU to the MTU value of the runtime management network
768: 	// so that the two MTUs match.
769: 	tplData.MgmtIPMTU = n.Runtime.Mgmt().MTU
770: 
771: 	if err := n.populateInterfaceConfig(&tplData); err != nil {
772: 		return err
773: 	}
774: 
775: 	buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
776: 
777: 	err = srlCfgTpl.Execute(buf, tplData)
778: 	if err != nil {
779: 		return err
780: 	}
781: 
782: 	log.Debugf("Node %q additional config:\n%s", n.Cfg.ShortName, buf.String())
783: 
784: 	// Copy overlay config to container
785: 	tmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(buf.String())
786: 	if err != nil {
787: 		return err
788: 	}
789: 	defer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)
790: 
791: 	err = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, defaultCfgPath, tmpFilePath)
792: 	if err != nil {
793: 		return fmt.Errorf("error copying configuration to container: %w", err)
794: 	}
795: 
796: 	// su to admin user to apply the default config
797: 	// to make sure that the 'environment save' command will create
798: 	// files with correct permissions
799: 	cmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{
800: 		"bash", "-c",
801: 		fmt.Sprintf("su -s /bin/bash admin -c '/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -ed < %s'", defaultCfgPath),
802: 	})
803: 
804: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
805: 	if err != nil {
806: 		return err
807: 	}
808: 
809: 	log.Debugf(
810: 		"node %s. stdout: %s, stderr: %s",
811: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
812: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
813: 		execResult.GetStdErrString(),
814: 	)
815: 
816: 	return nil
817: }
818: 
819: // populateInterfaceConfig adds endpoint settings to the default configuration,
820: // returning an error for interface names that cannot be mapped to SR Linux interfaces.
821: func (n *srl) populateInterfaceConfig(tplData *srlTemplateData) error {
822: 	const ethernetSplitParts = 3
823: 
824: 	const ethernetMTUOverhead = 14
825: 
826: 	for _, e := range n.Endpoints {
827: 		ifName := e.GetIfaceName()
828: 
829: 		// Runtime-discovered endpoints bypass topology interface-name validation.
830: 		if !normalizedInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(ifName) {
831: 			return fmt.Errorf(
832: 				"invalid SR Linux interface %q: expected %s or %s",
833: 				ifName, mgmt0InterfaceName, InterfaceHelp,
834: 			)
835: 		}
836: 
837: 		// Restored runtime endpoints may have no topology link or configured MTU.
838: 		mtu := clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU
839: 		if link := e.GetLink(); link != nil {
840: 			mtu = link.GetMTU()
841: 		}
842: 
843: 		if ifName == mgmt0InterfaceName {
844: 			if mtu != clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU {
845: 				tplData.MgmtMTU = mtu
846: 				tplData.MgmtIPMTU = mtu - ethernetMTUOverhead
847: 			}
848: 
849: 			continue
850: 		}
851: 
852: 		ifNameParts := strings.SplitN(strings.TrimPrefix(ifName, "e"), "-", ethernetSplitParts)
853: 
854: 		iface := tplIFace{}
855: 
856: 		iface.BaseName = fmt.Sprintf("ethernet-%s/%s", ifNameParts[0], ifNameParts[1])
857: 		if len(ifNameParts) == ethernetSplitParts {
858: 			iface.FullName = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", iface.BaseName, ifNameParts[2])
859: 			iface.HasBreakout = true
860: 		} else {
861: 			iface.FullName = iface.BaseName
862: 		}
863: 
864: 		if mtu != clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU {
865: 			iface.Mtu = mtu
866: 		}
867: 
868: 		if a := e.GetIPv4Addr(); a.IsValid() {
869: 			iface.IPv4 = a.String()
870: 		}
871: 
872: 		if a := e.GetIPv6Addr(); a.IsValid() {
873: 			iface.IPv6 = a.String()
874: 		}
875: 
876: 		tplData.IFaces[ifName] = iface
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	return nil
880: }
881: 
882: // addOverlayCLIConfig adds CLI formatted config that is read out of a file provided via
883: // startup-config directive.
884: func (n *srl) addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx context.Context) error {
885: 	if len(n.startupCliCfg) == 0 {
886: 		log.Debugf(
887: 			"node %q: startup-config empty, committing existing candidate",
888: 			n.Config().ShortName,
889: 		)
890: 
891: 		return nil
892: 	}
893: 
894: 	cfgStr := string(n.startupCliCfg)
895: 
896: 	log.Debugf(
897: 		"Node %q additional config from startup-config file %s:\n%s",
898: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
899: 		n.Cfg.StartupConfig,
900: 		cfgStr,
901: 	)
902: 
903: 	// Copy overlay config to container
904: 	tmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(cfgStr)
905: 	if err != nil {
906: 		return err
907: 	}
908: 	defer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)
909: 
910: 	err = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, overlayCfgPath, tmpFilePath)
911: 	if err != nil {
912: 		return fmt.Errorf("error copying configuration to container: %w", err)
913: 	}
914: 
915: 	// Load overlay config
916: 	cmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{
917: 		"bash", "-c",
918: 		fmt.Sprintf("su -s /bin/bash admin -c '/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -ed < %s'", overlayCfgPath),
919: 	})
920: 
921: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
922: 	if err != nil {
923: 		return err
924: 	}
925: 
926: 	if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
927: 		return fmt.Errorf("%w:%s", clabnodes.ErrCommandExecError, execResult.GetStdErrString())
928: 	}
929: 
930: 	log.Debugf(
931: 		"node %s. stdout: %s, stderr: %s",
932: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
933: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
934: 		execResult.GetStdErrString(),
935: 	)
936: 
937: 	return nil
938: }
939: 
940: // commitConfig commits and saves default+overlay config to the startup-config file.
941: func (n *srl) commitConfig(ctx context.Context) error {
942: 	log.Debugf("Node %q: committing configuration", n.Cfg.ShortName)
943: 
944: 	cmd, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(`bash -c "/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -ed commit save"`)
945: 	if err != nil {
946: 		return err
947: 	}
948: 
949: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
950: 	if err != nil {
951: 		return err
952: 	}
953: 
954: 	if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
955: 		return fmt.Errorf("%w:%s", clabnodes.ErrCommandExecError, execResult.GetStdErrString())
956: 	}
957: 
958: 	log.Debugf(
959: 		"node %s. stdout: %s, stderr: %s",
960: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
961: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
962: 		execResult.GetStdErrString(),
963: 	)
964: 
965: 	return nil
966: }
967: 
968: func (n *srl) generateCheckpoint(ctx context.Context) error {
969: 	cmd, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(
970: 		`bash -c '/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli /tools system configuration generate-checkpoint ` +
971: 			`name clab-initial comment \"set by containerlab\"'`,
972: 	)
973: 	if err != nil {
974: 		return err
975: 	}
976: 
977: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
978: 	if err != nil {
979: 		return err
980: 	}
981: 
982: 	if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
983: 		return fmt.Errorf("%w:%s", clabnodes.ErrCommandExecError, execResult.GetStdErrString())
984: 	}
985: 
986: 	log.Debugf(

996: // populateHosts adds container hostnames for other nodes of a lab to SR Linux /etc/hosts file
997: // to mitigate the fact that srlinux uses non default netns for management and thus
998: // can't leverage docker DNS service.
999: func (n *srl) populateHosts(ctx context.Context, nodes map[string]clabnodes.Node) error {
1000: 	hosts, err := n.Runtime.GetHostsPath(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName)
1001: 	if err != nil {
1002: 		log.Warnf("Unable to locate /etc/hosts file for srl node %v: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1003: 		return err
1004: 	}
1005: 
1006: 	var entriesv4, entriesv6 bytes.Buffer
1007: 
1008: 	const (
1009: 		v4Prefix = "###### CLAB-v4-START ######"
1010: 		v4Suffix = "###### CLAB-v4-END ######"
1011: 		v6Prefix = "###### CLAB-v6-START ######"
1012: 		v6Suffix = "###### CLAB-v6-END ######"
1013: 	)
1014: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "\n%s\n", v4Prefix)
1015: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "\n%s\n", v6Prefix)
1016: 
1017: 	for node, params := range nodes {
1018: 		if v4 := params.Config().MgmtIPv4Address; v4 != "" {
1019: 			fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "%s\t%s\n", v4, node)
1020: 		}
1021: 
1022: 		if v6 := params.Config().MgmtIPv6Address; v6 != "" {
1023: 			fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "%s\t%s\n", v6, node)
1024: 		}
1025: 	}
1026: 
1027: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "%s\n", v4Suffix)
1028: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "%s\n", v6Suffix)
1029: 
1030: 	// world-writable for container /etc/hosts
1031: 	const hostsFilePerm = 0o666
1032: 
1033: 	file, err := os.OpenFile(hosts, os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, hostsFilePerm) // skipcq: GSC-G302
1034: 	if err != nil {
1035: 		log.Warnf("Unable to open /etc/hosts file for srl node %v: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1036: 		return err
1037: 	}
1038: 
1039: 	_, err = file.Write(entriesv4.Bytes())
1040: 	if err != nil {
1041: 		return err
1042: 	}
1043: 
1044: 	_, err = file.Write(entriesv6.Bytes())
1045: 	if err != nil {
1046: 		return err
1047: 	}
1048: 
1049: 	return file.Close()
1050: }

1052: func (n *srl) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {
1053: 	captureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(n.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)
1054: 	if err != nil {
1055: 		return "", err
1056: 	}
1057: 
1058: 	indexGroups := []string{"linecard", "port", "channel"}
1059: 	parsedIndices := make(map[string]int)
1060: 	foundIndices := make(map[string]bool)
1061: 
1062: 	for _, indexKey := range indexGroups {
1063: 		if index, found := captureGroups[indexKey]; found && index != "" {
1064: 			foundIndices[indexKey] = true
1065: 
1066: 			parsedIndices[indexKey], err = strconv.Atoi(index)
1067: 			if err != nil {
1068: 				return "", fmt.Errorf(
1069: 					"%q parsed %s index %q could not be cast to an integer",
1070: 					ifName,
1071: 					indexKey,
1072: 					index,
1073: 				)
1074: 			}
1075: 
1076: 			if parsedIndices[indexKey] < 1 {
1077: 				return "", fmt.Errorf(
1078: 					"%q parsed %q index %q does not match requirement >= 1",
1079: 					ifName,
1080: 					indexKey,
1081: 					index,
1082: 				)
1083: 			}
1084: 		} else {
1085: 			foundIndices[indexKey] = false
1086: 		}
1087: 	}
1088: 
1089: 	if foundIndices["linecard"] && foundIndices["port"] {
1090: 		if foundIndices["channel"] {
1091: 			return fmt.Sprintf("e%d-%d-%d", parsedIndices["linecard"],
1092: 				parsedIndices["port"], parsedIndices["channel"]), nil
1093: 		} else {
1094: 			return fmt.Sprintf("e%d-%d", parsedIndices["linecard"], parsedIndices["port"]), nil
1095: 		}
1096: 	} else {
1097: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%q missing linecard or port index", ifName)
1098: 	}
1099: }

1101: // CheckInterfaceName checks if a name of the interface referenced in the topology file correct.
1102: func (n *srl) CheckInterfaceName() error {
1103: 	nm := strings.ToLower(n.Cfg.NetworkMode)
1104: 
1105: 	err := n.CheckInterfaceOverlap()
1106: 	if err != nil {
1107: 		return err
1108: 	}
1109: 
1110: 	for _, e := range n.Endpoints {
1111: 		if !normalizedInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(e.GetIfaceName()) {
1112: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1113: 				"nokia sr linux interface name %q doesn't match the required pattern: %s",
1114: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
1115: 				n.InterfaceHelp,
1116: 			)
1117: 		}
1118: 
1119: 		if e.GetIfaceName() == mgmt0InterfaceName && nm != "none" {
1120: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1121: 				"mgmt0 interface name is not allowed for %s node when network mode is not set to none",
1122: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
1123: 			)
1124: 		}
1125: 	}
1126: 
1127: 	return nil
1128: }

1130: // createRepoFiles creates apt/ym repository files

1132: func (n *srl) createRepoFiles() error {
1133: 	yumRepo := `[srlinux]
1134: name=SR Linux NDK apps
1135: baseurl=https://srlinux.fury.site/yum/
1136: enabled=1
1137: gpgcheck=0`
1138: 
1139: 	aptRepo := `deb [trusted=yes] https://srlinux.fury.site/apt/ /`
1140: 
1141: 	yumPath := n.Cfg.LabDir + "/yum.repo"
1142: 
1143: 	err := clabutils.CreateFile(yumPath, yumRepo)
1144: 	if err != nil {
1145: 		return err
1146: 	}
1147: 
1148: 	aptPath := n.Cfg.LabDir + "/apt.list"
1149: 
1150: 	err = clabutils.CreateFile(aptPath, aptRepo)
1151: 	if err != nil {
1152: 		return err
1153: 	}
1154: 
1155: 	// mount srlinux repository files
1156: 	n.Cfg.Binds = append(
1157: 		n.Cfg.Binds,
1158: 		yumPath+":/etc/yum.repos.d/srlinux.repo:ro",
1159: 		aptPath+":/etc/apt/sources.list.d/srlinux.list:ro")
1160: 
1161: 	return nil
1162: }
