deploy\n292: \tif _, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg); err != nil {\n293: \t\treturn err\n294: \t}\n295: \n296: \tif len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 1 {\n297: \t\tlog.Warn(\"Multiple line cards are rendered into the SR Linux topology file, but \"+\n298: \t\t\t\"deploying a node with more than one line card is not supported yet\",\n299: \t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"line cards\", len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components))\n300: \t}\n301: \n302: \tif n.Cfg.Cmd == \"\" {\n303: \t\t// set default Cmd if it was not provided by a user\n304: \t\t// the additional touch is needed to support non docker runtimes\n305: \t\tn.Cfg.Cmd = \"sudo -E bash -c 'touch /.dockerenv && /opt/srlinux/bin/sr_linux'\"\n306: \t}\n307: \n308: \tn.Cfg.Env = clabutils.MergeStringMaps(srlEnv, n.Cfg.Env)\n309: \n310: \t// if user was not initialized to a value, use root\n311: \tif n.Cfg.User == \"\" {\n312: \t\tn.Cfg.User = \"0:0\"\n313: \t}\n314: \n315: \t// restart the node when it is rebooted from within.\n316: \t// unless-stopped is used, as some images exit with code 0 on reboot;\n317: \t// on-failure is enough once all supported images exit with a non-zero code.\n318: \tif n.Cfg.RestartPolicy == \"\" {\n319: \t\tn.Cfg.RestartPolicy = \"unless-stopped\"\n320: \t}\n321: \n322: \tmaps.Copy(n.Cfg.Sysctls, srlSysctl)\n323: \n324: \tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" {\n325: \t\t// we mount a fixed path node.Labdir/license.key as the license referenced in topo file will\n326: \t\t// be copied to that path\n327: \t\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(\n328: \t\t\tfilepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\"), \":/opt/srlinux/etc/license.key:ro\"))\n329: \t}\n330: \n331: \t// mount config directory\n332: \tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\")\n333: \tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(cfgPath, \":/etc/opt/srlinux/:rw\"))\n334: \n335: \t// mount srlinux topology\n336: \tsrcTopoPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"topology.yml\")\n337: \tdstTopoPath := \"/tmp/topology.yml\"\n338: \t// if a user provided a topology file, it means that they want to use a custom srl topology file\n339: \t// in that case we do not need to mount the one for the provided type\n340: \tif !clabutils.DestinationBindMountExists(n.Cfg.Binds, dstTopoPath) {\n341: \t\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(srcTopoPath, \":\", dstTopoPath, \":ro\"))\n342: \t}\n343: \n344: \t// mounting /run/netnns as tmpfs ensures the network-instances\n345: \t// namespaces don't persist through stop/start/restarts.\n346: \tif n.Cfg.Tmpfs == nil {\n347: \t\tn.Cfg.Tmpfs = map[string]string{}\n348: \t}\n349: \n350: \tn.Cfg.Tmpfs[\"/run/netns\"] = \"rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec\"\n351: \n352: \tn.InterfaceRegexp = InterfaceRegexp\n353: \tn.InterfaceHelp = InterfaceHelp\n354: \n355: \treturn n.initNetnsNode()\n356: }\n357: \n358: func (n *srl) PreDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PreDeployParams) error {\n359: \tclabutils.CreateDirectory(n.Cfg.LabDir, clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n360: \n361: \t// store provided pubkeys\n362: \tn.sshPubKeys = params.SSHPubKeys\n363: \n364: \t// store the certificate-related parameters\n365: \t// for cert generation to happen in Post-Deploy phase with mgmt IPs as SANs\n366: \tn.cert = params.Cert\n367: \tn.topologyName = params.TopologyName\n368: \n369: \t// platform specific pre-deploy actions\n370: \t// modular chassis boot in the mode required by the line card generation they are populated\n371: \t// with, unless the user pinned the mode explicitly.\n372: \tif n.Config().Env[\"SRL_CHASSIS_MODE\"] == \"\" {\n373: \t\ttopology, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg)\n374: \t\tif err != nil {\n375: \t\t\treturn err\n376: \t\t}\n377: \n378: \t\tif topology.ChassisMode != \"\" {\n379: \t\t\tn.Config().Env[\"SRL_CHASSIS_MODE\"] = topology.ChassisMode\n380: \t\t}\n381: \t}\n382: \n383: \treturn n.createSRLFiles()\n384: }\n385: \n386: func (n *srl) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {\n387: \tlog.Info(\"Running postdeploy actions\",\n388: \t\t\"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind,\n389: \t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n390: \n391: \t// generate the certificate\n392: \tcertificate, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(n.cert, n.topologyName)\n393: \tif err != nil {\n394: \t\treturn err\n395: \t}\n396: \n397: \t// set the certificate data\n398: \tn.Config().TLSCert = string(certificate.Cert)\n399: \tn.Config().TLSKey = string(certificate.Key)\n400: \n401: \t// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface\n402: \tif err := n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {\n403: \t\tlog.Warnf(\"Unable to populate hosts for node %q: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n404: \t}\n405: \n406: \t// start waiting for initial commit and mgmt server ready\n407: \tif err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {\n408: \t\treturn err\n409: \t}\n410: \n411: \tn.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)\n412: \tif err != nil {\n413: \t\treturn err\n414: \t}\n415: \n416: \tn.supportsOpenconfig, err = n.OpenConfigFeatureEnabled(ctx)\n417: \tif err != nil {\n418: \t\treturn err\n419: \t}\n420: \n421: \t// return if config file is found in the lab directory.\n422: \t// This can be either if the startup-config has been mounted by that path\n423: \t// or the config has been previously generated and saved\n424: \tif clabutils.FileExists(filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")) {\n425: \t\treturn nil\n426: \t}\n427: \n428: \tif err := n.addDefaultConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n429: \t\treturn err\n430: \t}\n431: \n432: \tif err := n.addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n433: \t\treturn err\n434: \t}\n435: \n436: \t// once default and overlay config is added, we can commit the config\n437: \tif err := n.commitConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n438: \t\treturn err\n439: \t}\n440: \n441: \treturn n.generateCheckpoint(ctx)\n442: }\n443: \n444: func (n *srl) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {\n445: \tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(saveCmd)\n446: \n447: \texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n448: \tif err != nil {\n449: \t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%s: failed to execute cmd: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n450: \t}\n451: \n452: \tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n453: \t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%s errors: %s\", n.Cfg.ShortName, execResult.GetStdErrString())\n454: \t}\n455: \n456: \tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")\n457: \n458: \tlog.Infof(\n459: \t\t\"saved SR Linux configuration from %s node. Output:\\n%s\",\n460: \t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n461: \t\texecResult.GetStdOutString(),\n462: \t)\n463: \n464: \treturn &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{\n465: \t\tConfigPath: cfgPath,\n466: \t}, nil\n467: }\n468: \n469: // Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config\n470: // commands\n471: // returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.\n472: func (n *srl) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {\n473: \tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)\n474: \tdefer cancel()\n475: \n476: \tvar err error\n477: \n478: \tlog.Debugf(\"Waiting for SR Linux node %q to boot...\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n479: \n480: \tfor {\n481: \t\tselect {\n482: \t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n483: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n484: \t\t\t\t\"timed out waiting for SR Linux node %s to boot: %v\",\n485: \t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n486: \t\t\t\terr,\n487: \t\t\t)\n488: \t\tdefault:\n489: \t\t\t// two commands are checked, first if the mgmt_server is running\n490: \t\t\tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(mgmtServerRdyCmd)\n491: \n492: \t\t\texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n493: \t\t\tif err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {\n494: \t\t\t\tlogMsg := \"mgmt_server status check failed\"\n495: \n496: \t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n497: \t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\" error: %v\", err)\n498: \t\t\t\t}\n499: \n500: \t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {\n501: \t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\", output: \\n%s\", execResult)\n502: \t\t\t\t}\n503: \n504: \t\t\t\tlog.Debug(logMsg)\n505: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n506: \n507: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n508: \t\t\t}\n509: \n510: \t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n511: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n512: \t\t\t\t\t\"error during checking SR Linux boot status: %s\",\n513: \t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdErrString(),\n514: \t\t\t\t)\n515: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n516: \n517: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n518: \t\t\t}\n519: \n520: \t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"running\") {\n521: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n522: \n523: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n524: \t\t\t}\n525: \n526: \t\t\t// once mgmt server is running, we need to check if it is ready to accept configuration\n527: \t\t\t// commands\n528: \t\t\t// this is done with checking readyForConfigCmd\n529: \t\t\tcmd, _ = clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(readyForConfigCmd)\n530: \n531: \t\t\texecResult, err = n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n532: \t\t\tif err != nil {\n533: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"error during readyForConfigCmd execution: %s\", err)\n534: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n535: \n536: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n537: \t\t\t}\n538: \n539: \t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n540: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"readyForConfigCmd stderr: %s\", execResult.GetStdErrString())\n541: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n542: \n543: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n544: \t\t\t}\n545: \n546: \t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"loaded initial configuration\") {\n547: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n548: \t\t\t\t\t\"Management server readiness files doesn't contain the marker string %s\",\n549: \t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdOutString(),\n550: \t\t\t\t)\n551: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n552: \n553: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n554: \t\t\t}\n555: \n556: \t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Node %s is ready to accept configs\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n557: \n558: \t\t\treturn nil\n559: \t\t}\n560: \t}\n561: }\n562: \n563: // checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.\n564: func (*srl) checkKernelVersion() error {\n565: \t// retrieve running kernel version\n566: \tkv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()\n567: \tif err != nil {\n568: \t\treturn err\n569: \t}\n570: \n571: \t// do the comparison\n572: \tif !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {\n573: \t\tlog.Infof(\n574: \t\t\t\"Nokia SR Linux v23.3.1+ requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s\",\n575: \t\t\trequiredKernelVersion,\n576: \t\t\tkv,\n577: \t\t)\n578: \t}\n579: \n580: \treturn nil\n581: }\n582: \n583: func (n *srl) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {\n584: \t// perform the srl specific kernel version check\n585: \terr := n.checkKernelVersion()\n586: \tif err != nil {\n587: \t\treturn err\n588: \t}\n589: \n590: \treturn n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)\n591: }\n592: \n593: func (n *srl) createSRLFiles() error {\n594: \tlog.Debugf(\"Creating directory structure for SRL container: %s\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n595: \n596: \tvar src string\n597: \n598: \tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" {\n599: \t\t// copy license file to node specific directory in lab\n600: \t\tsrc = n.Cfg.License\n601: \n602: \t\tlicPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\")\n603: \t\tif err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), src, licPath,\n604: \t\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {\n605: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"CopyFile src %s -> dst %s failed %v\", src, licPath, err)\n606: \t\t}\n607: \n608: \t\tlog.Debugf(\"CopyFile src %s -> dst %s succeeded\", src, licPath)\n609: \t}\n610: \n611: \t// generate SRL topology file, including base MAC\n612: \terr := generateSRLTopologyFile(n.Cfg)\n613: \tif err != nil {\n614: \t\treturn err\n615: \t}\n616: \n617: \tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\"),\n618: \t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n619: \n620: \t// create repository files (for yum/apt) that\n621: \t// are mounted to srl container during the init phase\n622: \terr = n.createRepoFiles()\n623: \tif err != nil {\n624: \t\treturn err\n625: \t}\n626: \n627: \t// generate a startup config file\n628: \t// if the node has a `startup-config:` statement, the file specified in that section\n629: \t// will be used as a template in GenerateConfig()\n630: \tvar cfgTemplate string\n631: \n632: \tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")\n633: \tif n.Cfg.StartupConfig != \"\" {\n634: \t\tlog.Debug(\"Reading startup-config\", \"file\", n.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n635: \n636: \t\tc, err := os.ReadFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n637: \t\tif err != nil {\n638: \t\t\treturn err\n639: \t\t}\n640: \n641: \t\tcBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(bytes.NewReader(c), n.Cfg)\n642: \t\tif err != nil {\n643: \t\t\treturn err\n644: \t\t}\n645: \n646: \t\t// Determine if startup-config is a JSON file\n647: \t\t// Get slice of data with optional leading whitespace removed.\n648: \t\t// See RFC 7159, Section 2 for the definition of JSON whitespace.\n649: \t\tx := bytes.TrimLeft(cBuf.Bytes(), \" \\t\\r\\n\")\n650: \n651: \t\tisJSON := len(x) > 0 && x[0] == '{'\n652: \t\tif !isJSON {\n653: \t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n654: \t\t\t\t\"startup-config passed to %s is in the CLI format. Will apply it in post-deploy stage\",\n655: \t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n656: \t\t\t)\n657: \n658: \t\t\tn.startupCliCfg = cBuf.Bytes()\n659: \n660: \t\t\t// no need to generate and mount startup-config passed in a CLI format\n661: \t\t\t// as we will apply it over the top of a default config in the post deploy stage\n662: \t\t\treturn nil\n663: \t\t}\n664: \n665: \t\tcfgTemplate = cBuf.String()\n666: \t}\n667: \n668: \tif cfgTemplate == \"\" {\n669: \t\tlog.Debugf(\n670: \t\t\t\"configuration template for node %s is empty, skipping startup config file generation\",\n671: \t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n672: \t\t)\n673: \n674: \t\treturn nil\n675: \t}\n676: \n677: \terr = n.GenerateConfig(cfgPath, cfgTemplate)\n678: \tif err != nil {\n679: \t\tlog.Errorf(\"node=%s, failed to generate config: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n680: \t}\n681: \n682: \treturn err\n683: }\n684: \n685: // srlTemplateData top level data struct.\n686: type srlTemplateData struct {\n687: \tTLSKey     string\n688: \tTLSCert    string\n689: \tTLSAnchor  string\n690: \tTLSConfig  string\n691: \tBanner     string\n692: \tIFaces     map[string]tplIFace\n693: \tSSHPubKeys string\n694: \tMgmtMTU    int\n695: \tMgmtIPMTU  int\n696: \tDNSServers []string\n697: \t// EnableGNMIUnixSockServices enables GNMI unix socket services\n698: \t// for the node. This is needed for \"23.10 <= ver < 24.3\" versions\n699: \tEnableGNMIUnixSockServices bool\n700: \t// EnableCustomPrompt enables custom prompt with added newline\n701: \t// before the prompt.\n702: DNS servers configuration\n719: \tDNSServersConfig string\n720: }\n721: \n722: // tplIFace template interface struct.\n723: type tplIFace struct {\n724: \tBaseName    string // base interface excl. \t// set MgmtMTU to the MTU value of the runtime management network\n768: \t// so that the two MTUs match.\n769: \ttplData.MgmtIPMTU = n.Runtime.Mgmt().MTU\n770: \n771: \tif err := n.populateInterfaceConfig(&tplData); err != nil {\n772: \t\treturn err\n773: \t}\n774: \n775: \tbuf := new(bytes.Buffer)\n776: \n777: \terr = srlCfgTpl.Execute(buf, tplData)\n778: \tif err != nil {\n779: \t\treturn err\n780: \t}\n781: \n782: \tlog.Debugf(\"Node %q additional config:\\n%s\", n.Cfg.ShortName, buf.String())\n783: \n784: \t// Copy overlay config to container\n785: \ttmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(buf.String())\n786: \tif err != nil {\n787: \t\treturn err\n788: \t}\n789: \tdefer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)\n790: \n791: \terr = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, defaultCfgPath, tmpFilePath)\n792: \tif err != nil {\n793: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"error copying configuration to container: %w\", err)\n794: \t}\n795: \n796: \t// su to admin user to apply the default config\n797: \t// to make sure that the 'environment save' command will create\n798: \t// files with correct permissions\n799: \tcmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{\n800: for interface names that cannot be mapped to SR Linux interfaces.\n821: func (n *srl) populateInterfaceConfig(tplData *srlTemplateData) error {\n822: \tconst ethernetSplitParts = 3\n823: \n824: normalizedInterfaceRegexp validates names after AddEndpoint maps interface aliases.\n\tnormalizedInterfaceRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(\n\t\t`^(?:e[1-9]\\d*-[1-9]\\d*(?:-[1-9]\\d*)?|` + mgmt0InterfaceName + `)$`,\n\t)\n\tInterfaceHelp = \"ethernet-L/P, ethernet-L/P/C or eL-P, eL-P-C (where L, P, C >= 1)\"\n)\n\n// Register registers the node in the NodeRegistry.\nfunc Register(r *clabnodes.NodeRegistry) {\n\tgenerateNodeAttributes := clabnodes.NewGenerateNodeAttributes(generateable, generateIfFormat)\n\tplatformOpts := &clabnodes.PlatformAttrs{\n\t\tScrapliPlatformName: scrapliPlatformName,\n\t}\n\n\tnrea := clabnodes.NewNodeRegistryEntryAttributes(\n\t\tdefaultCredentials,\n\t\tgenerateNodeAttributes,\n\t\tplatformOpts,\n\t).WithKindSpecificConfig(kindSpecificConfig)\n\n\tr.Register(kindNames, func() clabnodes.Node {\n\t\treturn new(srl)\n\t}, nrea)\n}\n\n// KindSpecificConfig is the nokia_srlinux kind-specific config, set as keys on the node definition.\ntype KindSpecificConfig struct {\n\t// dedicated eda-mgmt gRPC server.\n\tEDADefaultGRPCServer bool `json:\"eda-default-grpc-server,omitempty\" yaml:\"eda-default-grpc-server,omitempty\"` //nolint:lll\n}\n\n// SetDefaults implements clabnodes.KindSpecificConfigDefaulter.\nfunc (c *KindSpecificConfig) SetDefaults() {\n\tc.CustomPrompt = true\n}\n\n// Component is an SR Linux line card.\ntype Component struct {\n\tSlot string byte\n\t// slice\n\tstartupCliCfg []byte\n\n\t// Params provided in Pre-Deploy, that srl uses in Post-Deploy phase\n\t// to generate certificates\n\tcert         *clabcert.Cert\n\ttopologyName OpenConfig server\n\tsupportsOpenconfig bool\n\t// holder of the node's network namespace\n\tnetnsNode *namespaceNode\n}\n\nfunc (*srl) LinkApplyMode(context.Context) clabnodes.LinkApplyMode {\n\treturn clabnodes.LinkApplyModeLive\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) kindSpecificCfg() *KindSpecificConfig { return kindSpecificConfig.Of(n.Cfg) }\n\nfunc (n *srl) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...clabnodes.NodeOption) error {\n\t// Init DefaultNode\n\tn.DefaultNode = *clabnodes.NewDefaultNode(n)\n\t// set virtualization requirement\n\tn.HostRequirements.SSSE3 = true\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinVCPU = 2\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinVCPUFailAction = clabtypes.FailBehaviourError\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinAvailMemoryGb = 2\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinAvailMemoryGbFailAction = clabtypes.FailBehaviourLog\n\n\tn.Cfg = cfg\n\n\t// force cert creation for srlinux nodes as they by make use of tls certificate in the default\n\t// config\n\tn.Cfg.Certificate.Issue = new(true)\n\n\tfor _, o := range opts {\n\t\to(n)\n\t}\n\n\tif n.Cfg.NodeType != \"\" && !strings.Contains(n.Cfg.NodeType, \"-\") {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\n\t\t\t\"Deprecation notice\",\n\t\t\t\"notice\",\n\t\t\t\"You are using a deprecated SR Linux node type name. \"+\n\t\t\t\t\"Consider using a new format with dashes. Example: ixr-d2l, ixr-h5-64d, etc.\\n\"+\n\t\t\t\t\"Deprecated type format will be removed after January 2026\",\n\t\t\t\"deprecated type\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.NodeType,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\tif n.Cfg.NodeType == \"\" {\n\t\tn.Cfg.NodeType = SRLinuxDefaultType\n\t}\n\n\tif _, found := srlTypes[n.Cfg.NodeType]; !found {\n\t\tkeys := make([]string, 0, len(srlTypes))\n\t\tfor key := range srlTypes {\n\t\t\tkeys = append(keys, key)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"wrong node type. '%s' doesn't exist. should be any of %s\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.NodeType, strings.Join(keys, \", \"))\n\t}\n\n\t// fail on an unusable components block here rather than midway through the deploy\n\tif _, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 1 {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\"Multiple line cards are rendered into the SR Linux topology file, but \"+\n\t\t\t\"deploying a node with more than one line card is not supported yet\",\n\t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"line cards\", len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components))\n\t}\n\n\tif n.Cfg.Cmd == \"\" \"0:0\"\n\t}\n\n\t// restart the node when it is rebooted from within.\n\t// unless-stopped is used, as some images exit with code 0 on reboot;\n\t// on-failure is enough once all supported images exit with a non-zero code.\n\tif n.Cfg.RestartPolicy == \"\" {\n\t\tn.Cfg.RestartPolicy = \"unless-stopped\"\n\t}\n\n\tmaps.Copy(n.Cfg.Sysctls, srlSysctl)\n\n\tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" {\n\t\t// we mount a fixed path node.Labdir/license.key as the license referenced in topo file will\n\t\t// be copied to that path\n\t\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(\n\t\t\tfilepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\"), \":/opt/srlinux/etc/license.key:ro\"))\n\t}\n\n\t// mount config directory\n\tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\")\n\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(cfgPath, \":/etc/opt/srlinux/:rw\"))\n\n\t// mount srlinux topology\n\tsrcTopoPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"topology.yml\")\n\tdstTopoPath := \"/tmp/topology.yml\"\n\t// if a user provided a topology file, it means that they want to use a custom srl topology file\n\t// in that case we do not need to mount the one for the provided type\n\tif !clabutils.DestinationBindMountExists(n.Cfg.Binds, dstTopoPath) {\n\t\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(srcTopoPath, \":\", dstTopoPath, \":ro\"))\n\t}\n\n\t// mounting /run/netnns as tmpfs ensures the network-instances\n\t// namespaces don't persist through stop/start/restarts.\n\tif n.Cfg.Tmpfs == nil {\n\t\tn.Cfg.Tmpfs = n.initNetnsNode()\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) PreDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PreDeployParams) error {\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(n.Cfg.LabDir, clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\n\t// store with, unless the user pinned the mode explicitly.\n\tif n.Config().Env[\"SRL_CHASSIS_MODE\"] == \"\" {\n\t\ttopology, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif topology.ChassisMode != \"\" {\n\t\t\tn.Config().Env[\"SRL_CHASSIS_MODE\"] = topology.ChassisMode\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.createSRLFiles()\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {\n\tlog.Info(\"Running postdeploy actions\",\n\t\t\"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind,\n\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\t// generate the certificate\n\tcertificate, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(n.cert, n.topologyName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// set the certificate data\n\tn.Config().TLSCert = string(certificate.Cert)\n\tn.Config().TLSKey = string(certificate.Key)\n\n\t// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface\n\tif err := n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\"Unable to populate hosts for node %q: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n\t}\n\n\t// start waiting for initial commit and mgmt server ready\n\tif err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.supportsOpenconfig, err = n.OpenConfigFeatureEnabled(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// return if config file is found in the lab directory.\n\t// This can be either if the startup-config has been mounted by that path\n\t// or the config has been previously generated and saved\n\tif clabutils.FileExists(filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")) {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.addDefaultConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// once default and overlay config is added, we can commit the config\n\tif err := n.commitConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.generateCheckpoint(ctx)\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {\n\tcmd, _ := execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%s errors: %s\", n.Cfg.ShortName, execResult.GetStdErrString())\n\t}\n\n\tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")\n\n\tlog.Infof(\n\t\t\"saved SR Linux configuration from %s node. sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config\n// commands\n// returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.\nfunc (n *srl) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)\n\tdefer cancel()\n\n\tvar err error\n\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Waiting for SR Linux node %q to boot...\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"timed out waiting for SR Linux node %s to boot: %v\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\t// two commands are checked, first if the mgmt_server is running\n\t\t\tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(mgmtServerRdyCmd)\n\n\t\t\texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n\t\t\tif err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {\n\t\t\t\tlogMsg := \"mgmt_server status check failed\"\n\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\" error: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\", output: \\n%s\", execResult)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debug(logMsg)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"error during checking SR Linux boot status: %s\",\n\t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdErrString(),\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"running\") {\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// once mgmt server is running, we need to check if it is ready to accept configuration\n\t\t\t// commands\n\t\t\t// this is done with checking readyForConfigCmd\n\t\t\tcmd, _ = clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(readyForConfigCmd)\n\n\t\t\texecResult, err = n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"error during readyForConfigCmd execution: %s\", err)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"readyForConfigCmd stderr: %s\", execResult.GetStdErrString())\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"loaded initial configuration\") {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"Management server readiness files doesn't contain the marker string %s\",\n\t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdOutString(),\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Node %s is ready to accept configs\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.\nfunc (*srl) checkKernelVersion() error {\n\t// retrieve running kernel version\n\tkv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// do the comparison\n\tif !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {\n\t\tlog.Infof(\n\t\t\t\"Nokia SR Linux v23.3.1+ requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s\",\n\t\t\trequiredKernelVersion,\n\t\t\tkv,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {\n\t// perform the srl specific kernel version check\n\terr := n.checkKernelVersion()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) createSRLFiles() error {\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Creating directory structure for SRL container: %s\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\tvar src string\n\n\tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" {\n\t\t// copy license file to node specific directory in lab\n\t\tsrc = n.Cfg.License\n\n\t\tlicPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\")\n\t\tif err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), src, licPath,\n\t\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"CopyFile src %s -> dst %s failed %v\", src, licPath, err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\"CopyFile src %s -> dst %s succeeded\", src, licPath)\n\t}\n\n\t// generate SRL topology file, including base MAC\n\terr := generateSRLTopologyFile(n.Cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\"),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\n\t// create repository files (for yum/apt) that\n\t// are mounted to srl container during the init phase\n\terr = n.createRepoFiles()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// generate a startup config file\n\t// if the node has a `startup-config:` statement, the file specified in that section\n\t// will be used as a template in GenerateConfig()\n\tvar cfgTemplate string\n\n\tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")\n\tif n.Cfg.StartupConfig != \"\" {\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Reading startup-config\", \"file\", n.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n\n\t\tc, err := os.ReadFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(bytes.NewReader(c), n.Cfg)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Determine if startup-config is a JSON file\n\t\t// Get slice of data with optional leading whitespace removed.\n\t\t// See RFC 7159, Section 2 for the definition of JSON whitespace.\n\t\tx := bytes.TrimLeft(cBuf.Bytes(), \" \\t\\r\\n\")\n\n\t\tisJSON := len(x) > 0 && x[0] == '{'\n\t\tif !isJSON {\n\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\t\"startup-config passed to %s is in the CLI format. Will apply it in post-deploy stage\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tn.startupCliCfg = cBuf.Bytes()\n\n\t\t\t// no need to generate and mount startup-config passed in a CLI format\n\t\t\t// as we will apply it over the top of a default config in the post deploy stage\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcfgTemplate = cBuf.String()\n\t}\n\n\tif cfgTemplate == \"\" {\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\"configuration template for node %s is empty, skipping startup config file generation\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t)\n\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\terr = n.GenerateConfig(cfgPath, cfgTemplate)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"node=%s, failed to generate config: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// srlTemplateData top level data struct.\ntype srlTemplateData struct {\n\tTLSKey     string\n\tTLSCert    string\n\tTLSAnchor  string\n\tTLSConfig  string\n\tBanner     string\n\tIFaces     map[string]tplIFace\n\tSSHPubKeys string\n\tMgmtMTU    int\n\tMgmtIPMTU  int\n\tDNSServers []string\n\t// EnableGNMIUnixSockServices enables GNMI unix socket services\n\t// for the node. This is needed for \"23.10 <= ver < 24.3\" versions\n\tEnableGNMIUnixSockServices bool\n\t// EnableCustomPrompt enables custom prompt with added newline\n\t// before the prompt.\n\tEnableCustomPrompt bool\n\tCustomPrompt       string\n\t// SNMPConfig is a string containing SNMP configuration\n\tSNMPConfig string\n\t// GRPCConfig is a string containing GRPC configuration\n\tGRPCConfig string\n\t// ACLConfig is a string containing ACL configuration\n\tACLConfig string\n\t// NetconfConfig is a string containing Netconf server configuration\n\tNetconfConfig string\n\t// EDAConfig is a string containing EDA configuration\n\tEDAConfig string\n\t// OCServerConfig is a string containing OpenConfig server configuration\n\tOCServerConfig string\n\t// NDKServerConfig is a string containing NDK server configuration\n\tNDKServerConfig string\n\t// DNSServersConfig is a string containing DNS servers configuration\n\tDNSServersConfig string\n}\n\n// tplIFace template interface struct.\ntype tplIFace struct {\n\tBaseName    string // base interface excl. breakout\n\tFullName    string // full interface name incl. breakout\n\tHasBreakout bool\n\tMtu         int\n\tIPv4        string\n\tIPv6        string\n}\n\n// addDefaultConfig adds srl default configuration such as tls certs, gnmi/json-rpc, login-banner.\nfunc (n *srl) addDefaultConfig(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tb, err := n.banner()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tvar dnsServers []string\n\tif n.Config().DNS != nil {\n\t\tdnsServers = n.Config().DNS.Servers\n\t}\n\n\t// tplData holds data used in templating of the default config snippet\n\ttplData := srlTemplateData{\n\t\tTLSKey:           n.Cfg.TLSKey,\n\t\tTLSCert:          n.Cfg.TLSCert,\n\t\tTLSAnchor:        n.Cfg.TLSAnchor,\n\t\tBanner:           b,\n\t\tIFaces:           map[string]tplIFace{},\n\t\tMgmtMTU:          0,\n\t\tMgmtIPMTU:        0,\n\t\tDNSServers:       dnsServers,\n\t\tSNMPConfig:       snmpv2Config,\n\t\tGRPCConfig:       grpcConfig,\n\t\tOCServerConfig:   \"\",\n\t\tNDKServerConfig:  \"\",\n\t\tDNSServersConfig: \"\",\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.setVersionSpecificParams(&tplData); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.setCustomPrompt(&tplData)\n\n\t// set MgmtMTU to the MTU value of the runtime management network\n\t// so that the two MTUs match.\n\ttplData.MgmtIPMTU = n.Runtime.Mgmt().MTU\n\n\tif err := n.populateInterfaceConfig(&tplData); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tbuf := new(bytes.Buffer)\n\n\terr = srlCfgTpl.Execute(buf, tplData)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Node %q additional config:\\n%s\", n.Cfg.ShortName, buf.String())\n\n\t// Copy overlay config to container\n\ttmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(buf.String())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tdefer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)\n\n\terr = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, defaultCfgPath, tmpFilePath)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"error copying configuration to container: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// su to admin user to apply the default config\n\t// to make sure that the 'environment save' command will create\n\t// files with correct permissions\n\tcmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{\n\t\t\"bash\", \"-c\",\n\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"su -s /bin/bash admin -c 389: func (d *DefaultNode) ComputeReconcilePlan(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) *ReconcileResult {
390: 	result := &ReconcileResult{Action: clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone}
391: 
392: 	if diff == nil || !diff.HasDiff() {
393: 		return result
394: 	}
395: 
396: 	action := diff.DefaultAction()
397: 	result.Action = action
398: 
399: 	switch action {
400: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
401: 		result.Restarted = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
402: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
403: 		result.Recreated = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	return result
407: }
408: 
409: func (d *DefaultNode) GetReconcilePlan(
410: 	_ context.Context,
411: 	diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,
412: ) (*ReconcileResult, error) {
413: 	return d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff), nil
414: }
415: 
416: // Reconcile applies the diff and executes the appropriate action (restart/recreate).
417: func (d *DefaultNode) Reconcile(
418: 	ctx context.Context,
419: 	diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,
420: ) (*ReconcileResult, error) {
421: 	result := d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff)
422: 
423: 	if result.Action == clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {
424: 		return result, nil
425: 	}
426: 
427: 	log.Info(
428: 		"Applying node changes",
429: 		"node",
430: 		d.Cfg.ShortName,
431: 		"action",
432: 		result.Action,
433: 		"fields",
434: 		diff.Fields,
435: 	)
436: 
437: 	switch result.Action {
438: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
439: 		if err := d.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
440: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("stop failed: %w", err)
441: 		}
442: 		if err := d.Start(ctx); err != nil {
443: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("start failed: %w", err)
444: 		}
445: 
446: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
447: 		if err := d.Delete(ctx); err != nil {
448: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("delete failed: %w", err)
449: 		}
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	return result, nil
453: }

223: func runtimeContainerLess(a, b clabruntime.GenericContainer) bool {
224: 	aName := runtimeContainerNodeName(a)
225: 	bName := runtimeContainerNodeName(b)
226: 
227: 	aOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(aName)
228: 	bOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(bName)
229: 	if aOrder != bOrder {
230: 		return aOrder < bOrder
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	return aName < bName
234: }
235: 
236: func runtimeComponentSortOrder(name string) int {
237: 	idx := strings.LastIndex(name, "-")
238: 	if idx < 0 || idx == len(name)-1 {
239: 		return 0
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	slot := strings.ToUpper(name[idx+1:])
243: 	if len(slot) == 1 && slot[0] >= 'A' && slot[0] <= 'Z' {
244: 		return 100 - int(slot[0])
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	var n int
248: 	for _, r := range slot {
249: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
250: 			return 0
251: 		}
252: 		n = n*10 + int(r-'0')
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	return n
256: }

Reasoning
`createNetworks` sets `NodeMgmtNetBr` on `n.Config().Labels` for each node in `c.Nodes` — this happens BEFORE node Deploy (networks created first in the deploy sequence). 28: +
29: +A reboot issued from within the node, for example with `tools platform chassis reboot`, restarts the SR Linux container. The node comes back with its links, saved configuration and management address intact.

31: +To support that, SR Linux nodes default to the `unless-stopped` [restart policy](../nodes.md#restart-policy), and containerlab keeps the links and the management address of each node in an internal `<node-name>-netns` container. The docs say nodes with user-defined network-mode "do not use the internal container" — but the restart policy default applies to them anyway. Is that intended? A root-namespace-based srl (e.g., kind running in host netns) with unless-stopped: if the srl process exits, docker restarts it. For host-network srl, restart is... probably fine? But here's a REAL concern: setting the default restart policy in `srl.Init` means the policy is baked into `n.Cfg.RestartPolicy` → persisted in the lab state? No — the topology NodeConfig comes from topology resolution; `Init` mutates the config at load time. For `network-mode: container:foo` srl nodes: usesNetnsNode false; srl container with unless-stopped: on reboot, the container exits, docker restarts it, re-joins the peer container's netns. Fine.

        "text": "}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) deleteNodes(ctx context.Context, workers uint) {\n\twg := new(sync.WaitGroup)\n\n\tconcurrentChan := make(chan clabnodes.Node)\n\n\tworkerFunc := func(i uint, input chan clabnodes.Node, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {\n\t\tdefer wg.Done()\n\n\t\tfor {\n\t\t\tselect {\n\t\t\tcase n := <-input:\n\t\t\t\tif n == nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Worker %d terminating...\", i)\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\terr := n.Delete(ctx)\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"could not remove container %q: %v\", n.Config().LongName, err)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// start concurrent workers\n\twg.Add(int(workers))\n\n\tfor i := range workers {\n\t\tgo workerFunc(i, concurrentChan, wg)\n\t}\n\n\t// send nodes to workers\n\tfor _, n := range c.Nodes {\n\t\tconcurrentChan <- n\n\t}\n\n\t// close channel to terminate the workers\n\tclose(concurrentChan)\n\n\t// also call delete on the special nodes\n\tspecialNodes := append(\n\t\t[]clablinks.Node{clablinks.GetHostLinkNode()},\n\t\tclablinks.GetMgmtBrLinkNodes()...,\n\t)\n\tfor _, n := range specialNodes {\n\t\terr := n.Delete(ctx)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Warn(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\twg.Wait()\n}\n\n// deleteContainersDirect deletes containers directly via the runtime API.\n// This is used when we don't have node objects (e.g., destroy-by-name-only case).",
